960	/-! ## Shape of `transfer` (§63) -/
961	
962	/-- Places after a transfer: owners within `src` move to the corresponding part of `dst` (§63,
963	`ok` effect). -/
964	theorem transfer_P_get (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) :
965	    (transferEff s src dst).P[q]? = (s.P[q]?).map fun pl =>
966	      if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then { pl with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pl.owner } else pl := by
967	  simp [transferEff]
968	
969	/-- Authorities after a transfer: holders within `src` move to the corresponding part of `dst`
970	(§63, `ok` effect). -/
971	theorem transfer_A_get (s : S3) (src dst j : Nat) :
972	    (transferEff s src dst).A[j]? = (s.A[j]?).map fun y =>
973	      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y := by
974	  simp [transferEff]
975	
976	/-- A transfer keeps the number of places (§63). -/
977	theorem transfer_len (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
978	    (transferEff s src dst).P.length = s.P.length := by simp [transferEff]
979	
980	/-- A transfer keeps the structural parents (§63). -/
981	theorem transfer_parentOf (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
982	    parentOf (transferEff s src dst).P = parentOf s.P := by
983	  funext i; simp only [parentOf, transfer_P_get]
984	  cases s.P[i]? with
985	  | none => rfl
986	  | some pl => simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some]; split <;> rfl
987	
988	/-- A transfer keeps the footprints (§63). -/
989	theorem transfer_footprint (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) :
990	    footprint (transferEff s src dst).P q = footprint s.P q :=
991	  footprint_congr (transfer_len s src dst) (transfer_parentOf s src dst) q
992	
993	/-- A transfer keeps the structural parts (§63). -/
994	theorem transfer_partOf (s : S3) (src dst r q : Nat) :
995	    partOf (transferEff s src dst).P r q ↔ partOf s.P r q := by
996	  simp only [partOf, transfer_parentOf, transfer_len]
997	
998	/-- Membership in the children of a place (§63.2). -/
999	theorem mem_kids {P : List Place} {x r : Nat} :
1000	    r ∈ kids P x ↔ r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = some x := by
1001	  simp [kids, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range]
1002	
1003	/-- A place has no children exactly when it is a leaf (§40, §63.2). -/
1004	theorem kids_nil_iff {P : List Place} {l : Nat} : kids P l = [] ↔ isLeaf P l := by
1005	  constructor
1006	  · intro h r hr hp
1007	    have : r ∈ kids P l := mem_kids.2 ⟨hr, hp⟩
1008	    rw [h] at this; simp at this
1009	  · intro h
1010	    exact nil_of_forall_not_mem fun r hr => by
1011	      obtain ⟨hr, hp⟩ := mem_kids.1 hr; exact h r hr hp
1012	
1013	/-- Any fuel at least the index gives the same `corr` (§63.2). -/
1014	theorem corrF_fuel (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) :
1015	    ∀ n m r, r ≤ n → r ≤ m → corrF P src dst n r = corrF P src dst m r
1016	  | 0, 0, _, _, _ => rfl
1017	  | 0, m + 1, r, h, _ => by
1018	    obtain rfl : r = 0 := by omega
1019	    simp only [corrF]; split
1020	    · rfl
1021	    · split
1022	      · split
1023	        · omega
1024	        · rfl
1025	      · rfl
1026	  | n + 1, 0, r, _, h => by
1027	    obtain rfl : r = 0 := by omega
1028	    simp only [corrF]; split
1029	    · rfl
1030	    · split
1031	      · split
1032	        · omega
1033	        · rfl
1034	      · rfl
1035	  | n + 1, m + 1, r, h₁, h₂ => by
1036	    simp only [corrF]; split
1037	    · rfl
1038	    · split
1039	      · split
1040	        · rw [corrF_fuel P src dst n m _ (by omega) (by omega)]
1041	        · rfl
1042	      · rfl
1043	
1044	/-- `corr(src) = dst` (§63.2). -/
1045	theorem corr_src (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : corr P src dst src = some dst := by
1046	  unfold corr; cases src <;> simp [corrF]
1047	
1048	/-- `corr(r)` for a part other than `src`: the child at the position of `r` among the children
1049	of its parent, under the place corresponding to that parent (§63.2). -/
1050	theorem corr_step {P : List Place} {src dst r p : Nat} (hr : r ≠ src)
1051	    (hp : parentOf P r = some p) (hlt : p < r) :
1052	    corr P src dst r = (corr P src dst p).bind fun p' => (kids P p')[posIn r (kids P p)]? := by
1053	  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, r = n + 1 := ⟨r - 1, by omega⟩
1054	  unfold corr
1055	  simp only [corrF, hr, ↓reduceIte, hp, hlt]
1056	  rw [corrF_fuel P src dst n p _ (by omega) (Nat.le_refl p)]
1057	
1058	/-- An element found at an index belongs to the list (§63.2). -/
1059	theorem getElem?_mem {l : List Nat} {i x : Nat} (h : l[i]? = some x) : x ∈ l :=
1060	  List.mem_of_getElem? h
1061	
1062	/-- The place corresponding to a part of `src` is a part of `dst` (§63.2). -/
1063	theorem corr_partOf {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst : Nat} (hd : dst < s.P.length) :
1064	    ∀ n r r', r < n → corr s.P src dst r = some r' → partOf s.P r' dst
1065	  | 0, _, _, h, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
1066	  | n + 1, r, r', hr, h => by
1067	    by_cases e : r = src
1068	    · subst e; rw [corr_src] at h; cases h; exact ⟨hd, .inl rfl⟩
1069	    cases hp : parentOf s.P r with
1070	    | none =>
1071	      unfold corr at h
1072	      cases r with
1073	      | zero => simp [corrF, e] at h
1074	      | succ m => simp [corrF, e, hp] at h
1075	    | some p =>
1076	      have hlt := (hw.parent_lt hp).1
1077	      rw [corr_step e hp hlt] at h
1078	      cases hc : corr s.P src dst p with
1079	      | none => rw [hc] at h; cases h
1080	      | some p' =>
1081	        rw [hc] at h; simp only [Option.bind_some] at h
1082	        have ih := corr_partOf hw hd n p p' (by omega) hc
1083	        obtain ⟨hr'l, hr'p⟩ := mem_kids.1 (getElem?_mem h)
1084	        have hlt' := (hw.parent_lt hr'p).1
1085	        refine ⟨hr'l, .inr ?_⟩
1086	        rw [chain_cons hr'p hlt']
1087	        rcases ih.2 with rfl | hc'
1088	        · exact List.mem_cons_self ..
1089	        · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hc'
1090	
1091	/-- A holder within `src` moves to a part of `dst` (§63, `ok` effect). -/
1092	theorem mvTo_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst : Nat} (hd : dst < s.P.length) {h : Holder}
1093	    (hh : heldIn s.P src h) : ∃ r', mvTo s.P src dst h = .place r' ∧ partOf s.P r' dst := by
1094	  cases h with
1095	  | frame f => exact hh.elim
1096	  | place r =>
1097	    cases hc : corr s.P src dst r with
1098	    | none => exact ⟨dst, by simp [mvTo, hc], hd, .inl rfl⟩
1099	    | some r' =>
1100	      exact ⟨r', by simp [mvTo, hc], corr_partOf hw hd (r + 1) r r' (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hc⟩
1101	
1102	/-- A holder within `src` moves to a place (§63, `ok` effect). -/
1103	theorem mvTo_place {P : List Place} {src dst : Nat} {h : Holder} (hh : heldIn P src h) :
1104	    ∃ r', mvTo P src dst h = .place r' := by
1105	  cases h with
1106	  | frame _ => exact hh.elim
1107	  | place r => exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

1110	theorem transfer_owner_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst r' : Nat} (hr' : partOf s.P r' dst) :
1111	    ∃ pd pr, (transferEff s src dst).P[dst]? = some pd ∧
1112	      (transferEff s src dst).P[r']? = some pr ∧ pr.owner = pd.owner := by
1113	  obtain ⟨pl, pd, hpl, hpd, ho⟩ := hw.ownerOf hr'
1114	  refine ⟨_, _, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpd]; rfl, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; rfl, ?_⟩
1115	  show (if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then _ else pl).owner =
1116	    (if heldIn s.P src pd.owner then _ else pd).owner
1117	  rw [ho]; split
1118	  · rfl
1119	  · exact ho
1120

1122	theorem transfer_usable_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst r' : Nat} (hr' : partOf s.P r' dst)
1123	    (hd' : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst) : (transferEff s src dst).Usable r' := by
1124	  obtain ⟨pd, pr, hpd, hpr, ho⟩ := transfer_owner_part (src := src) hw hr'
1125	  exact hd'.of_same hpd hpr ho (by show s.dead r' = s.dead dst; exact hw.deadOf hr')

1128	theorem transfer_pframe_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst r' : Nat} (hr' : partOf s.P r' dst) :
1129	    (transferEff s src dst).pframe r' = (transferEff s src dst).pframe dst := by
1130	  obtain ⟨pd, pr, hpd, hpr, ho⟩ := transfer_owner_part (src := src) hw hr'
1131	  exact pframe_eq_of_owner hpd hpr ho

1133	/-- A transfer creates and duplicates no authority: it changes holders only (§63, §53). -/
1134	theorem transfer_skel (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : SameSkel s (transferEff s src dst) := by
1135	  refine ⟨by simp [transferEff], fun j => ?_⟩
1136	  rw [transfer_A_get]
1137	  cases s.A[j]? with
1138	  | none => rfl
1139	  | some y => simp only [Option.map_some]; split <;> rfl

1141	/-- A place usable after a transfer of a usable `src` was usable before (§40, §63). -/
1142	theorem transfer_usable_back {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (hsrc : s.Usable src)
1143	    {q : Nat} (h : (transferEff s src dst).Usable q) : s.Usable q := by
1144	  induction h with
1145	  | @frame q f pl hpl hd ho hf =>
1146	    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
1147	    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
1148	    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl
1149	    | some pl =>
1150	      rw [h'] at hpl; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hpl; subst hpl
1151	      split at ho
1152	      · rename_i hh
1153	        obtain ⟨r', e⟩ := mvTo_place (dst := dst) hh
1154	        simp [e] at ho
1155	      · exact .frame h' hd ho hf
1156	  | @place q o pl hpl hd ho _ ih =>
1157	    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
1158	    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
1159	    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl
1160	    | some pl =>
1161	      rw [h'] at hpl; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hpl; subst hpl
1162	      split at ho
1163	      · rename_i hh

1165	        | frame f => rw [hpo] at hh; exact hh.elim
1166	        | place r =>

1168	          exact .place h' hd hpo (usable_of_partOf hwf (r + 1) r src (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hh hsrc)

obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, e⟩ := h.get hx; simp [skel] at e
  exact hw a x₀ hx₀ l (e.2.2.1 ▸ hl)

theorem SameSkel.rootChain {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (hc : RootChain s)
    (hlen : s'.P.length = s.P.length) (hpar : parentOf s'.P = parentOf s.P) : RootChain s' :=
  hc.transport hlen hpar (fun a => by rw [h.ancs])
    (fun a y' ha => by obtain ⟨y, hy, e⟩ := h.get ha; simp [skel] at e; exact ⟨y, hy, e.2.2.1⟩)
    (fun x z hz hzo => by
      obtain ⟨z', hz', e⟩ := h.get' hz; simp [skel] at e; exact ⟨z', hz', e.2.1.trans hzo, e.2.2.1⟩)

/-! ## Preservation by `transfer` (MM-03.3 §3, O4; A4; A5) -/

theorem transfer_P_get (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) :
    (transferEff s src dst).P[q]? = (s.P[q]?).map fun pl =>
      if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then { pl with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pl.owner } else pl := by
  simp [transferEff]

theorem transfer_A_get (s : S3) (src dst j : Nat) :
    (transferEff s src dst).A[j]? = (s.A[j]?).map fun y =>
      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y := by
  simp [transferEff]

theorem transfer_len (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    (transferEff s src dst).P.length = s.P.length := by simp [transferEff]

theorem transfer_parentOf (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    parentOf (transferEff s src dst).P = parentOf s.P := by
  funext i; simp only [parentOf, transfer_P_get]
  cases s.P[i]? with
  | none => rfl
  | some pl => simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some]; split <;> rfl

theorem transfer_footprint (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) :
    footprint (transferEff s src dst).P q = footprint s.P q :=
  footprint_congr (transfer_len s src dst) (transfer_parentOf s src dst) q

theorem transfer_partOf (s : S3) (src dst r q : Nat) :
    partOf (transferEff s src dst).P r q ↔ partOf s.P r q := by
  simp only [partOf, transfer_parentOf, transfer_len]

theorem mem_kids {P : List Place} {x r : Nat} :
    r ∈ kids P x ↔ r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = some x := by
  simp [kids, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range]

theorem kids_nil_iff {P : List Place} {l : Nat} : kids P l = [] ↔ isLeaf P l := by
  constructor
  · intro h r hr hp
    have : r ∈ kids P l := mem_kids.2 ⟨hr, hp⟩
    rw [h] at this; simp at this
  · intro h
    exact nil_of_forall_not_mem fun r hr => by
      obtain ⟨hr, hp⟩ := mem_kids.1 hr; exact h r hr hp

theorem corrF_fuel (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) :
    ∀ n m r, r ≤ n → r ≤ m → corrF P src dst n r = corrF P src dst m r
  | 0, 0, _, _, _ => rfl
  | 0, m + 1, r, h, _ => by
    obtain rfl : r = 0 := by omega
    simp only [corrF]; split
    · rfl
    · split
      · split
        · omega
        · rfl
      · rfl
  | n + 1, 0, r, _, h => by
    obtain rfl : r = 0 := by omega
    simp only [corrF]; split
    · rfl
    · split
      · split
        · omega
        · rfl
      · rfl
  | n + 1, m + 1, r, h₁, h₂ => by
    simp only [corrF]; split
    · rfl
    · split
      · split
        · rw [corrF_fuel P src dst n m _ (by omega) (by omega)]
        · rfl
      · rfl

theorem corr_src (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : corr P src dst src = some dst := by
  unfold corr; cases src <;> simp [corrF]

theorem corr_step {P : List Place} {src dst r p : Nat} (hr : r ≠ src)
    (hp : parentOf P r = some p) (hlt : p < r) :
    corr P src dst r = (corr P src dst p).bind fun p' => (kids P p')[posIn r (kids P p)]? := by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, r = n + 1 := ⟨r - 1, by omega⟩
  unfold corr
  simp only [corrF, hr, ↓reduceIte, hp, hlt]
  rw [corrF_fuel P src dst n p _ (by omega) (Nat.le_refl p)]

theorem getElem?_mem {l : List Nat} {i x : Nat} (h : l[i]? = some x) : x ∈ l :=
  List.mem_of_getElem? h

/-- The place corresponding to a part of `src` is a part of `dst` (J1). -/
theorem corr_partOf {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst : Nat} (hd : dst < s.P.length) :
    ∀ n r r', r < n → corr s.P src dst r = some r' → partOf s.P r' dst
  | 0, _, _, h, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, r, r', hr, h => by
    by_cases e : r = src
    · subst e; rw [corr_src] at h; cases h; exact ⟨hd, .inl rfl⟩
    cases hp : parentOf s.P r with
    | none =>
      unfold corr at h
      cases r with
      | zero => simp [corrF, e] at h
      | succ m => simp [corrF, e, hp] at h
    | some p =>
      have hlt := (hw.parent_lt hp).1
      rw [corr_step e hp hlt] at h
      cases hc : corr s.P src dst p with
      | none => rw [hc] at h; cases h
      | some p' =>
        rw [hc] at h; simp only [Option.bind_some] at h
        have ih := corr_partOf hw hd n p p' (by omega) hc
        obtain ⟨hr'l, hr'p⟩ := mem_kids.1 (getElem?_mem h)
        have hlt' := (hw.parent_lt hr'p).1
        refine ⟨hr'l, .inr ?_⟩
        rw [chain_cons hr'p hlt']
        rcases ih.2 with rfl | hc'
        · exact List.mem_cons_self ..
        · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hc'

/-- A holder within the source moves to a part of the destination (J1, A4, A5). -/
theorem mvTo_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst : Nat} (hd : dst < s.P.length) {h : Holder}
    (hh : heldIn s.P src h) : ∃ r', mvTo s.P src dst h = .place r' ∧ partOf s.P r' dst := by
  cases h with
  | frame f => exact hh.elim
  | place r =>
    cases hc : corr s.P src dst r with
    | none => exact ⟨dst, by simp [mvTo, hc], hd, .inl rfl⟩
    | some r' =>
      exact ⟨r', by simp [mvTo, hc], corr_partOf hw hd (r + 1) r r' (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hc⟩

theorem mvTo_place {P : List Place} {src dst : Nat} {h : Holder} (hh : heldIn P src h) :
    ∃ r', mvTo P src dst h = .place r' := by
  cases h with
  | frame _ => exact hh.elim
  | place r => exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

/-- Places with the same owner have the same frame (A5). -/
theorem pframe_eq_of_owner {s : S3} {q r : Nat} {pq pr : Place} (hq : s.P[q]? = some pq)
    (hr : s.P[r]? = some pr) (h : pr.owner = pq.owner) : s.pframe r = s.pframe q := by
  simp only [S3.pframe, pframeF, hq, hr, h]

/-- In the arrival state of a transfer, a part of the destination has the owner of the
destination (A5, J1): their owners were equal before (`WF3`) and change under the same rule. -/
theorem transfer_owner_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst r' : Nat} (hr' : partOf s.P r' dst) :
    ∃ pd pr, (transferEff s src dst).P[dst]? = some pd ∧ (transferEff s src dst).P[r']? = some pr ∧
      pr.owner = pd.owner := by
  obtain ⟨pl, pd, hpl, hpd, ho⟩ := hw.ownerOf hr'
  refine ⟨_, _, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpd]; rfl, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; rfl, ?_⟩
  show (if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then _ else pl).owner = (if heldIn s.P src pd.owner then _ else pd).owner
  rw [ho]; split
  · rfl
  · exact ho

/-- A part of the destination is usable after the transfer when the destination is (A5, J1). -/
theorem transfer_usable_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst r' : Nat} (hr' : partOf s.P r' dst)
    (hd' : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst) : (transferEff s src dst).Usable r' := by
  obtain ⟨pd, pr, hpd, hpr, ho⟩ := transfer_owner_part (src := src) hw hr'
  exact hd'.of_same hpd hpr ho (by show s.dead r' = s.dead dst; exact hw.deadOf hr')

/-- A part of the destination has the frame of the destination after the transfer (A5, J1). -/
theorem transfer_pframe_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst r' : Nat} (hr' : partOf s.P r' dst) :
    (transferEff s src dst).pframe r' = (transferEff s src dst).pframe dst := by
  obtain ⟨pd, pr, hpd, hpr, ho⟩ := transfer_owner_part (src := src) hw hr'
  exact pframe_eq_of_owner hpd hpr ho

/-- `transfer` changes no skeleton: it creates and duplicates no authority (O4.3). -/
theorem transfer_skel (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : SameSkel s (transferEff s src dst) := by
  refine ⟨by simp [transferEff], fun j => ?_⟩
  rw [transfer_A_get]
  cases s.A[j]? with
  | none => rfl
  | some y => simp only [Option.map_some]; split <;> rfl

/-- A place usable after the transfer was usable before (A5). -/
theorem transfer_usable_back {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (hsrc : s.Usable src) {q : Nat}
    (h : (transferEff s src dst).Usable q) : s.Usable q := by
  induction h with
  | @frame q f pl hpl hd ho hf =>
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl
    | some pl =>
      rw [h'] at hpl; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hpl; subst hpl
      split at ho
      · rename_i hh
        obtain ⟨r', e⟩ := mvTo_place (dst := dst) hh
        simp [e] at ho
      · exact .frame h' hd ho hf
  | @place q o pl hpl hd ho _ ih =>
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl
    | some pl =>
      rw [h'] at hpl; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hpl; subst hpl
      split at ho
      · rename_i hh
        cases hpo : pl.owner with
        | frame f => rw [hpo] at hh; exact hh.elim
        | place r =>
          rw [hpo] at hh
          exact .place h' hd hpo (usable_of_partOf hwf (r + 1) r src (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hh hsrc)
      · exact .place h' hd ho ih

/-- A place usable before the transfer stays usable when the destination is usable after it
(A5; J1: the places owned by a part of the source are owned by a part of the destination). -/
theorem transfer_usable_fwd {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hw : WF3 s)
    (hd' : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst) {q : Nat} (h : s.Usable q) :
    (transferEff s src dst).Usable q := by
  have hdl : dst < s.P.length := by have := hd'.lt; rwa [transfer_len] at this
  induction h with
  | @frame q f pl hpl hd ho hf =>
    exact .frame (by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; rfl) hd (by simp [ho, heldIn]) hf
  | @place q o pl hpl hd ho _ ih =>
    by_cases hh : heldIn s.P src (.place o)
    · obtain ⟨r', e, hr'⟩ := mvTo_part hw hdl hh
      exact .place (by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; rfl) hd (by simp [ho, hh, e])
        (transfer_usable_part hw hr' hd')
    · exact .place (by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; rfl) hd (by simp [ho, hh]) ih

/-- `transfer` preserves `RootHeld` (A4): the holder of a root and the owner of its root place
change together, under the same condition. -/
theorem transfer_rootHeld {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hr : RootHeld s) :
    RootHeld (transferEff s src dst) := by
  intro x z' l r hx ho hl hrp hlr
  rw [transfer_A_get] at hx
  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hx
  have ho' : z.origin = none := by split at ho <;> exact ho
  have hl' : l ∈ z.footprint := by split at hl <;> exact hl
  have hrp' : RootPlace s.P r := by simpa only [RootPlace, transfer_len, transfer_parentOf] using hrp
  have hlr' : partOf s.P l r := (transfer_partOf s src dst l r).1 hlr
  obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hh⟩ := hr x z l r hz ho' hl' hrp' hlr'
  refine ⟨_, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpr]; rfl, ?_⟩
  by_cases hc : heldIn s.P src pr.owner <;> simp [hc, hh]

/-- `transfer` preserves `WF3` and `Inv3base` (MM-03.3 §3, O4; §10; A4; A5). -/
theorem transfer_preserves {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3base s)
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) : WF3 s' ∧ Inv3base s' := by
  obtain ⟨⟨hsrc, -, hdst, -, -, -, -, hd', -, h5, -, -, -, -, -⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have sk := transfer_skel s src dst
  obtain ⟨i1, i2, i3, -⟩ := hinv
  refine ⟨⟨sk.origin hwf.origin, ?_, hwf.ne, hwf.nodup, hwf.frames, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_,
    sk.rootChain hwf.rootChain (transfer_len s src dst) (transfer_parentOf s src dst),
    transfer_rootHeld hwf.rootHeld⟩,
    sk.i1 i1, sk.i2 i2, fun q hq x hx => ?_, i4_always _⟩
  · rw [transfer_len]; exact sk.fp hwf.fp
  · intro q pl f hq ho
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hq
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hq; cases hq
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hq; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hq; subst hq
      split at ho
      · rename_i hh
        obtain ⟨r', e⟩ := mvTo_place (dst := dst) hh
        simp [e] at ho
      · exact hwf.ownerFrame q pl₀ f h' ho
  · intro q pl o hq ho
    rw [transfer_len]; rw [transfer_P_get] at hq
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hq; cases hq
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hq; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hq; subst hq
      split at ho
      · rename_i hh
        obtain ⟨r', e, hr'⟩ := mvTo_part hwf hdst.lt hh
        simp only [e, Holder.place.injEq] at ho; subst ho; exact hr'.1
      · exact hwf.ownerPlace q pl₀ o h' ho
  · intro q pl r hq hp
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hq
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hq; cases hq
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hq; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hq; subst hq
      have hp₀ : pl₀.parent = some r := by split at hp <;> exact hp
      obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hlt, ho, hdd⟩ := hwf.parts q pl₀ r h' hp₀
      refine ⟨_, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpr]; rfl, hlt, ?_, hdd⟩
      by_cases hc : heldIn s.P src pl₀.owner <;> simp [hc, ho]
  · intro a y hy ya
    rw [transfer_A_get] at hy
    cases h' : s.A[a]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hy; cases hy
    | some y₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hy; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hy; subst hy
      have ya₀ : y₀.active = true := by split at ya <;> exact ya
      have hl := hwf.poss a y₀ h' ya₀
      split
      · rename_i hh
        obtain ⟨r', e, hr'⟩ := mvTo_part hwf hdst.lt hh
        show HolderLive _ (mvTo s.P src dst y₀.holder)
        rw [e]; exact transfer_usable_part hwf hr' hd'
      · cases hh : y₀.holder with
        | frame f => rw [hh] at hl; exact hl
        | place p => rw [hh] at hl; exact transfer_usable_fwd hwf hd' hl
  · have hq' := transfer_usable_back hwf hsrc hq
    refine sk.active.2 ?_
    simp only [transferEff] at hx
    split at hx
    · rename_i hqd; subst hqd; rcases List.mem_append.1 hx with hx | hx
      · exact i3 _ hq' x hx
      · exact h5 x hx
    · split at hx
      · simp at hx
      · exact i3 q hq' x hx

/-- `transfer_no_duplicate_authority` (MM-03.3 §3, O4.3; §2, I4; §10; A4): no authority is
created or duplicated, each keeps mode, origin, footprint and activity; an authority held by the
source or one of its parts is now held by the corresponding part of the destination (`mvTo`, J1);
the others keep their holder, so a root held by a frame never moves. -/
theorem transfer_no_duplicate_authority {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) :
    SameSkel s s' ∧ ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[b]? = some y →
      s'.A[b]? = some (if heldIn s.P src y.holder then
        { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y) := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact ⟨transfer_skel s src dst, fun b y hy => by rw [transfer_A_get, hy]; rfl⟩

/-- Ownership moves with the value (A5; J1): every place owned by the source or one of its parts is
now owned by the corresponding part of the destination, and keeps its parent (it does not move). -/
theorem transfer_moves_ownership {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) :
    ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place), s.P[q]? = some pl →
      s'.P[q]? = some (if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then
        { pl with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pl.owner } else pl) := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact fun q pl hq => by rw [transfer_P_get, hq]; rfl

/-- J1: after an accepted transfer, an authority held by a part `r` of the source is held by the
corresponding part of the destination, which exists and is a part of `dst`; so is a place owned by
`r`, whose root, held by `r` (`RootHeld`), follows with it. -/
theorem transfer_to_corresponding_parts {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) {r : Nat} (hr : partOf s.P r src) :
    ∃ r', corr s.P src dst r = some r' ∧ partOf s.P r' dst ∧
      (∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[b]? = some y → y.holder = .place r →
        s'.A[b]? = some { y with holder := .place r' }) ∧
      (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place r →
        s'.P[q]? = some { pl with owner := .place r' }) := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hsh := hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
  have h1 := hsh.1 r (List.mem_range.2 hr.1) hr
  unfold OptP at h1; split at h1
  · rename_i r' hc
    refine ⟨r', hc, corr_partOf hwf hpre.2.2.1.lt (r + 1) r r' (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hc,
      fun b y hy hh => ?_, fun q pl hq ho => ?_⟩
    · rw [transfer_A_get, hy]; simp [hh, heldIn, hr, mvTo, hc]
    · rw [transfer_P_get, hq]; simp [ho, heldIn, hr, mvTo, hc]
  · exact h1.elim

/-- `transfer_invalidates_source` (MM-03.3 §3, O4; §2, I4): after a transfer, every leaf of the
source is `Moved` and readable by no authority. -/
theorem transfer_invalidates_source {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) :
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s'.I l = .moved ∧ ∀ a, ¬ CanReadLeaf s' a l := by
  obtain ⟨⟨-, -, -, -, hov, -⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  intro l hl
  have hm : (transferEff s src dst).I l = .moved := by
    simp only [transferEff, show l ∉ footprint s.P dst from fun h' => hov ⟨l, hl, h'⟩, hl,
      ↓reduceIte]
  exact ⟨hm, fun a => i4_always _ a l hm⟩

/-- Moved dependencies (MM-03.3.6; MM-03.3 §3, O4): those of the source go with the destination
and leave the source and its parts. -/
theorem transfer_moves_deps {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) :
    (∀ x ∈ depsOf s src, x ∈ s'.D dst) ∧ ∀ r, r ≠ dst → partOf s.P r src → s'.D r = [] := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact ⟨fun x hx => by simp [transferEff, hx], fun r hr hp => by simp [transferEff, hr, hp]⟩

/-- F5: an accepted `transfer` has disjoint footprints of source and destination. The clause is
the explicit precondition `¬ overlap s.P src dst` of `TransferPre`. -/
theorem transfer_footprints_disjoint {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, l ∉ footprint s.P dst :=
  fun l hl hl' => (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.2.2.2.2.1 ⟨l, hl, hl'⟩

/-- F5: the clause `¬ overlap s.P src dst` of `TransferPre` is redundant: it follows from clause 1
(source initialised) and clause 2 (destination without an `Init` leaf). It stays explicit (F5:
nothing removed). -/
theorem transfer_overlap_redundant {s : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (h1 : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init)
    (h2 : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) : ¬ overlap s.P src dst :=
  fun ⟨l, hl, hl'⟩ => h2 l hl' (h1 l hl)

/-! ## Preservation by `depend`, `read3`, `write3` -/

theorem WF3.of_eq {s s' : S3} (h : WF3 s) (hA : s'.A = s.A) (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F)
    (hn : s'.nF = s.nF) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead) : WF3 s' := by
  obtain ⟨w0, w2, wne, wnd, wfr, wof, wop, wpa, wpo, wrc, wrh⟩ := h
  refine ⟨hA ▸ w0, by rw [hA, hP]; exact w2, hF ▸ wne, hF ▸ wnd, by rw [hF, hn]; exact wfr,
    by rw [hP, hn]; exact wof, by rw [hP]; exact wop, by rw [hP, hd]; exact wpa, ?_,
    wrc.transport (by rw [hP]) (by rw [hP])
      (fun a => by unfold S3.ancs; congr 1; funext i; simp only [S3.org, hA])
      (fun a y' h => ⟨y', hA ▸ h, rfl⟩)
      (fun x z h hz => ⟨z, hA ▸ h, hz, rfl⟩),
    wrh.transport hP fun x z h' hz => ⟨z, hA ▸ h', hz, rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  intro a y hy ya

theorem transfer_D (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) : (transferEff s src dst).D q =
    if q = dst then s.D dst ++ depsOf s src else if partOf s.P q src then [] else s.D q := rfl

theorem depsOf_sub_movedDeps {s : S3} {src x : Nat} (h : x ∈ depsOf s src) :
    x ∈ movedDeps s src := by
  simp only [depsOf, movedDeps, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq] at h ⊢
  obtain ⟨r, ⟨hr, hp⟩, hx⟩ := h
  exact ⟨r, ⟨hr, .inl hp⟩, hx⟩

theorem mem_movedDeps_owned {s : S3} {src q x : Nat} (hq : s.Usable q) (ho : OwnedIn s.P src q)
    (hx : x ∈ s.D q) : x ∈ movedDeps s src := by
  simp only [movedDeps, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq, List.mem_range]
  exact ⟨q, ⟨hq.lt, .inr ⟨ownedWithin_iff.2 ho, hq⟩⟩, hx⟩

theorem transfer_frameOf_fwd {s : S3} {src dst q f : Nat} (h : FrameOf s q f)
    (hn : ¬ OwnedIn s.P src q) : FrameOf (transferEff s src dst) q f := by
  induction h with
  | @frame q f pl hpl ho =>
    exact .frame (pl := pl) (by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; simp [ho, heldIn]) ho
  | @place q o f pl hpl ho hf ih =>
    have h1 : ¬ partOf s.P o src := fun hp => hn (.direct hpl ho hp)
    have h2 : ¬ OwnedIn s.P src o := fun ho' => hn (.step hpl ho ho')
    exact .place (pl := pl) (by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; simp [ho, heldIn, h1]) ho (ih h2)

theorem transfer_frameOf_back {s : S3} {src dst q f : Nat} (h : FrameOf (transferEff s src dst) q f) :
    (FrameOf s q f ∧ ¬ OwnedIn s.P src q) ∨
      (OwnedIn s.P src q ∧ ∃ r, partOf s.P r src ∧
        FrameOf (transferEff s src dst) ((corr s.P src dst r).getD dst) f) := by
  induction h with
  | @frame q f pl hpl ho =>
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with

        | step h1 h2 _ => rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2
  | @place q o f pl hpl ho hf ih =>
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hpl; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hpl; subst hpl
      split at ho
      · rename_i hh

        | place r =>

          simp only [mvTo, Holder.place.injEq] at ho

          cases hq with
          | direct h1 h2 h3 =>
            rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2; exact hh (by rw [ho]; exact h3)
          | step h1 h2 h3 => rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2; exact hn h3
        · exact .inr ⟨.step h' ho ho', hd⟩

theorem OwnedIn.of_owner {P : List Place} {src q r : Nat} {pq pr : Place} (hq : P[q]? = some pq)
    (hr : P[r]? = some pr) (ho : pr.owner = pq.owner) (h : OwnedIn P src q) : OwnedIn P src r := by
  cases h with
  | direct h1 h2 h3 => rw [hq] at h1; cases h1; exact .direct hr (ho.trans h2) h3
  | step h1 h2 h3 => rw [hq] at h1; cases h1; exact .step hr (ho.trans h2) h3

/-- The destination of an accepted transfer is not owned by the source: its owner chain would
come back to it (A5; J1: through the part of the destination that corresponds to the owner). -/
theorem transfer_dst_not_owned {s : S3} {src dst f : Nat} (hw : WF3 s) :
    ∀ {q}, FrameOf (transferEff s src dst) q f → OwnedIn s.P src q → ¬ OwnedIn s.P src dst := by
  intro q h
  induction h with
  | @frame q f pl hpl ho =>
    intro hq _
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hpl; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hpl; subst hpl
      split at ho
      · rename_i hh
        obtain ⟨r', e⟩ := mvTo_place (dst := dst) hh
        simp [e] at ho
      · cases hq with
        | direct h1 h2 _ => rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2
        | step h1 h2 _ => rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2
  | @place q o f pl hpl ho hf ih =>
    intro hq hd
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hpl; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hpl; subst hpl
      split at ho
      · rename_i hh
        obtain ⟨r', e, hr'⟩ := mvTo_part hw hd.lt hh
        simp only [e, Holder.place.injEq] at ho; subst ho
        obtain ⟨pl', pd, hpl', hpd, ho'⟩ := hw.ownerOf hr'
        exact ih (hd.of_owner hpd hpl' ho') hd
      · rename_i hh
        cases hq with
        | direct h1 h2 h3 =>
          rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2; exact hh (by rw [ho]; exact h3)
        | step h1 h2 h3 => rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2; exact ih h3 hd

theorem transfer_pframe_unmoved {s : S3} {src dst q : Nat} (hn : ¬ OwnedIn s.P src q) :
    (transferEff s src dst).pframe q = s.pframe q :=
  Option.ext fun f => by
    rw [pframe_iff, pframe_iff]
    exact ⟨fun h => (transfer_frameOf_back h).elim (fun h => h.1) (fun h => absurd h.1 hn),
      fun h => transfer_frameOf_fwd h hn⟩

/-- An anchor whose effective anchor does not move with the value keeps its order (B8, C1; A4,
A5). -/
theorem transfer_effAnchorOK_unmoved {s : S3} {src dst x : Nat} {z : Authority}
    (hz : s.A[s.effAnchor x]? = some z) (hm : ¬ AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor x))
    (fd : Option Nat) :
    EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x fd ↔ EffAnchorOK s x fd := by
  have hm' : ¬ HolderMoves s src z.holder := by unfold AnchorMoves at hm; rw [hz] at hm; exact hm
  have hnh : ¬ heldIn s.P src z.holder := by
    cases hh : z.holder with
    | frame g => simp [heldIn]
    | place p => rw [hh] at hm'; exact fun h => hm' (.inl h)
  have he : (transferEff s src dst).effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x :=
    effAnchor_congr (by rw [(transfer_skel s src dst).ancs])
  refine effAnchorOK_of_same (z' := z) hz (by rw [he, transfer_A_get, hz]; simp [hnh]) ?_
    (fun _ _ _ => Iff.rfl) rfl
  cases hh : z.holder with
  | frame g => rfl
  | place p =>
    rw [hh] at hm'
    exact transfer_pframe_unmoved (fun ho => hm' (.inr (ownedWithin_iff.2 ho)))

/-- `transfer` preserves `AnchorOrder` (B8, C1; MM-03.3 §3, O4; MM-03.3.6), under `WF3`: when the
effective anchor or the dependent moves, by the clause B8; otherwise both frames are unchanged. -/
theorem transfer_preserves_anchorOrder {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (hao : AnchorOrder s) (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrder s' := by
  obtain ⟨⟨hsrc, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, h8, -⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  intro q hq x hx
  by_cases hm : AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor x) ∨ q = dst ∨ OwnedWithin s src q
  · exact h8 q (List.mem_range.2 (by have := hq.lt; rwa [transfer_len] at this)) hq x hx hm
  have hm1 : ¬ AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor x) := fun e => hm (.inl e)
  have hm2 : q ≠ dst := fun e => hm (.inr (.inl e))
  have hown : ¬ OwnedIn s.P src q := fun e => hm (.inr (.inr (ownedWithin_iff.2 e)))
  have hq0 := transfer_usable_back hwf hsrc hq
  rw [transfer_D] at hx; simp only [hm2, ↓reduceIte] at hx
  split at hx
  · simp at hx
  · have hok := hao q hq0 x hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hok.get
    rw [transfer_pframe_unmoved hown]
    exact (transfer_effAnchorOK_unmoved hz hm1 _).2 hok

/-- `exitFrame` preserves `AnchorOrder` (B8, C1; MM-03.3 §4, O7; A7), under `WF3`: re-anchoring
replaces an anchor by an authority of its chain, which has the same effective anchor, and the
frame of a usable place stays below the popped frame. -/
theorem exit_preserves_anchorOrder {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hwf : WF3 s) (hao : AnchorOrder s)
    (h : ExitStep k s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrder s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  unfold ExitPre at hpre
  split at hpre
  · rename_i f F₀ hF
    obtain ⟨-, hR1, h3, -⟩ := hpre
    have e := exitEff_eq hF
    have hP : (exitEff s).P = s.P := by rw [e]
    have hnd := (List.nodup_cons.1 (hF ▸ hwf.nodup)).1
    intro q hq x' hx'
    have hq₁ : ({ s with F := F₀ } : S3).Usable q :=
      (S3.Usable.congr (s := ({ s with F := F₀ } : S3)) hP (by rw [e]) (by rw [e])).1 hq
    have hq₀ : s.Usable q :=
      S3.Usable.mono (s := s) (s' := ({ s with F := F₀ } : S3)) rfl
        (fun g hg => by rw [hF]; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hg) (fun _ h => h) hq₁
    rw [e] at hx'; simp only [List.mem_map] at hx'
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hx'
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.1 (hR1 q (List.mem_range.2 hq₀.lt) hq₁ x hx)
    rw [hz]; simp only [Option.getD_some]
    have hok := hao q hq₀ x hx
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hro⟩ := reanchor_reaches_root hwf.origin (x + 1) x (Nat.lt_succ_self x)
    have hex : s.effAnchor x = r := effAnchor_eq (x + 1) x (Nat.lt_succ_self x) r hr hro
    have hzx : z = x ∨ z ∈ s.ancs x := List.mem_cons.1 (firstSurv_some hz).1
    have hrz : r = z ∨ r ∈ s.ancs z := by
      rcases hzx with rfl | hzx
      · exact hr
      · rcases hr with rfl | hr
        · rw [S3.ancs, chain_none hro] at hzx; simp at hzx
        · exact ancs_root_after (x + 1) x (Nat.lt_succ_self x) z r hzx hr hro
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hok.get
    rw [hex] at hy
    have hyo : y.origin = none := by simpa [S3.org, hy] using hro
    have hro' : (exitEff s).org r = none := by
      simp only [S3.org, exit_A_get hF, hy, Option.map_some, Option.bind_some]
      rcases exitG_origin (s := s) (F₀ := F₀) (a := r) (y := y) with e' | ⟨-, hn, -⟩
      · rw [e']; exact hyo
      · exact absurd hyo hn
    have hrz' : r = z ∨ r ∈ (exitEff s).ancs z := hrz.imp id fun hh =>
      exit_root_kept hF h3 (z + 1) z (Nat.lt_succ_self z) r hh hro
    have hez : (exitEff s).effAnchor z = r := effAnchor_eq (z + 1) z (Nat.lt_succ_self z) r hrz' hro'
    refine (effAnchorOK_of_same (s := s) (s' := exitEff s) (x := x) (x' := z)
      (z' := exitG s F₀ r y) (by rw [hex]; exact hy) (by rw [hez, exit_A_get hF, hy]; rfl)
      (by rw [(exitG_same s F₀ r y).2.2, S3.hframe_congr hP]) ?_ (S3.pframe_congr hP q)).2 hok
    intro g f₁ hf
    obtain ⟨f', hf', hfF⟩ := hq₁.frameOf
    rw [pframe_iff.2 ((FrameOf.congr (s := s) (s' := ({ s with F := F₀ } : S3)) rfl).1 hf')] at hf
    rw [← Option.some.inj hf]
    have hne : (f != f') = true := by simpa using fun e => hnd (by rw [e]; exact hfF)
    rw [show (exitEff s).F = F₀ by rw [e]]
    show g ∈ F₀.dropWhile (· != f') ↔ g ∈ s.F.dropWhile (· != f')
    rw [hF, List.dropWhile_cons]; simp only [hne, ↓reduceIte]
  · exact hpre.elim

/-! ## Exercise requires holding (A2, B2) -/

/-- `exercise_requires_hold` (A2), by mode (B2): an authority exercisable at mode `m` is active, its
mode permits `m`, and it is held by the current frame, or held by a place on which the current
frame already has an authority exercisable at `m` with an effective mode permitting `m`. -/
theorem exercise_requires_hold {s : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} (h : s.ExercisableAt a m) :
    ∃ y, s.A[a]? = some y ∧ y.active = true ∧ m.le y.mode ∧
      (y.holder = .frame s.top ∨ ∃ p, y.holder = .place p ∧ HasRight s m p) := by
  cases h with
  | base hy ha hm hf => exact ⟨_, hy, ha, hm, .inl hf⟩
  | @held _ p b _ y hy ha hm hp hb hc =>
    have hlt : b < s.A.length := by
      cases hb with
      | base hy' _ _ _ => exact lt_of_getElem? hy'

import Ern.MM03.Horrors

/-!
# Measure of the `NoLock` options (jalon 3, step 4)

The options of the jalon-3 material (`ERN_Jalon3_materiel.md` v2, §5), measured on the kernel as it
is (option 1, no rule), without modifying it:

* option 2, a local rule: an operation does not place an authority into a place it covers
  (`SelfLock`); `store` already rejects it (O8.3), so the rule is measured on `transfer` and
  `issue` (`opt2`);
* option 3, `NoLock`: no self-lock, as a separate clause, and the relation "`b` blocks `a`"
  (`Blocks`) acyclic, checked on the arrival state of `transfer`, `issue` and `store` (`opt3`).

For each case of the list "doit être accepté" of §5 (H11, H19, H29b, H35 to H37, H44 to H47, W1
to W3) and for H49 to H51, `decisions` gives the decision of an option on each `transfer`, `issue`
and `store` of the run of the case (`Ern.MM03.Horrors`), decided on the state where the step runs;
`true` is acceptance. The cost, measured as the brief asks (from the authorities and places the
operation touches, or the whole state): option 2 on `transfer` depends on the state only through the
places and the authorities the transfer moves (`opt2_transfer_local`), on `issue` only through the
region and the destination (`opt2_issue_local`); option 3 depends on authorities the operation does
not touch (`opt3_not_local`). Whether option 3 needs more than the function where the operation runs
(material §5, "locale à une fonction") is not settled here (report, (g)). No option is adopted (task
of jalon 3, step 4: the decision is left to arbitration).
-/

namespace Ern.MM03.LockOptions

open Ern.MM03 Ern.HandlePool Ern.MM03.Horrors

/-! ## Option 2: self-lock -/

/-- The leaves of a holder (MM-03.3.4): those of a place, none for a frame. -/
def holderLeaves (s : S3) : Holder → List Nat
  | .place p => footprint s.P p
  | .frame _ => []

/-- Self-lock of the authority `a` (material §5, options 2 and 3): `a` is active and held by a place
one of whose leaves it covers. -/
def SelfLock (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ holderLeaves s y.holder) False

instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (SelfLock s a) := by unfold SelfLock; infer_instance

/-- Option 2 on `transfer src dst` (material §5): no authority moved by the transfer, one held within
the source, is self-locked in the arrival state. -/
def Opt2Transfer (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => heldIn s.P src y.holder) False →
    ¬ SelfLock (transferEff s src dst) j

instance (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (Opt2Transfer s src dst) := by
  unfold Opt2Transfer; infer_instance

/-- Option 2 on `issue` of `region` to `dst` (material §5): the block, the new authority, is not
self-locked in the arrival state. -/
def Opt2Issue (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  ¬ SelfLock (issueEff s ar region dst).1 s.A.length

instance (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (Opt2Issue s ar region dst) := by
  unfold Opt2Issue; infer_instance

/-! ## Option 3: `NoLock` -/

/-- "`b` bloque `a`" (material §5, option 3): `b ≠ a`, both active, and the footprint of `b` contains
a leaf of the holder of `a`. -/
def Blocks (s : S3) (b a : Nat) : Prop :=
  b ≠ a ∧ s.Active b ∧ s.Active a ∧
    OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => ∃ l ∈ s.afp b, l ∈ holderLeaves s y.holder) False

instance (s : S3) (b a : Nat) : Decidable (Blocks s b a) := by unfold Blocks; infer_instance

/-- The authorities blocked by one of `xs`. -/
def blockedBy (s : S3) (xs : List Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range s.A.length).filter fun a => decide (∃ b ∈ xs, Blocks s b a)

/-- The authorities reached from `xs` by at most `n` steps of `Blocks`, `xs` included. -/
def blockReach (s : S3) : Nat → List Nat → List Nat
  | 0, xs => xs
  | n + 1, xs => blockReach s n (xs ++ blockedBy s xs)

/-- Acyclicity of `Blocks` (material §5, option 3): no authority is reached from itself by one or
more steps. Every step leads to an authority of `A`, so a cycle has at most `A.length` steps and the
search with that bound is complete (report, (f)). -/
def BlocksAcyclic (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∉ blockReach s s.A.length (blockedBy s [a])

instance (s : S3) : Decidable (BlocksAcyclic s) := by unfold BlocksAcyclic; infer_instance

/-- `NoLock` (material §5, option 3): no self-lock (separate clause) and `Blocks` acyclic. -/
def NoLock (s : S3) : Prop :=
  (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ SelfLock s a) ∧ BlocksAcyclic s

instance (s : S3) : Decidable (NoLock s) := by unfold NoLock; infer_instance

/-! ## Decisions along the runs -/

/-- Option 2 on an operation from the extended state `ps` (`true`: accepted by the rule). Only
`transfer` and `issue` are checked; `store` is left to O8.3. -/
def opt2 (ps : PS) : Op → Bool
  | .transfer src dst => decide (Opt2Transfer ps.s src dst)
  | .issue i _ region dst =>
    match ps.s.arenas[i]? with
    | some ar => decide (Opt2Issue ps.s ar region dst)
    | none => true
  | _ => true

/-- Option 3 on an operation from `ps` (`true`: accepted by the rule): `NoLock` of the arrival
state of `transfer`, `issue` and `store`. -/
def opt3 (ps : PS) : Op → Bool
  | .transfer src dst => decide (NoLock (transferEff ps.s src dst))
  | .issue i _ region dst =>
    match ps.s.arenas[i]? with
    | some ar => decide (NoLock (arenaSet (issueEff ps.s ar region dst).1 i
        (issueEff ps.s ar region dst).2))
    | none => true
  | .store a p => decide (NoLock (storeEff ps.s a p))
  | _ => true

/-- The operations checked by the options: `transfer`, `issue`, `store`. -/
def checked : Op → Bool
  | .transfer .. => true
  | .issue .. => true
  | .store .. => true
  | _ => false

/-- The decisions of the option `D` on the checked steps of a run of `K0` from `ps`, each on the
state where the step runs, in order, as long as the steps are `ok` in the kernel. -/
def decisions (D : PS → Op → Bool) (ps : PS) : List Op → List Bool
  | [] => []
  | o :: os =>
    match pexec K0 ps o with
    | some ps' => (if checked o then [D ps o] else []) ++ decisions D ps' os
    | none => []

/-- The run from `S3.init []` of a case. -/
def dec2 (os : List Op) : List Bool := decisions opt2 (PS.init []) os
def dec3 (os : List Op) : List Bool := decisions opt3 (PS.init []) os

/-! ## Cases that must be accepted (material §5) -/

/-- The runs of the cases that must be accepted, with their names: each is a run of
`Ern.MM03.Horrors` reached under `K0`, except H21's arena which is not on the list. -/
def mustAccept : List (String × List Op) :=
  [("H11", h11p ++ [.endUse 3, .endUse 6, .reset 0 0]),
   ("H19", h19p ++ [.endUse 2, .reset 0 0]),
   ("H29b", h29bo), ("H35", h35o), ("H36", h36o), ("H37", h37o), ("H44", h44o),
   ("H45", h45o), ("H46", h46o), ("H47", h47o), ("W1", w1o),
   ("W2", w2o ++ [.release 12, .release 11, .transfer 9 16, .transfer 12 19]),
   ("W3", w3o ++ [.endUse 5, .endUse 2, .endUse 3, .endUse 4, .reset 0 0, .issue 0 0 [10] 2]),
   ("W3v", w3vo ++ [.endUse 2, .reset 0 0, .issue 0 0 [10] 3])]

/-- Every run of the list is `ok` in the kernel at each step, so the decisions cover all its
checked steps. -/
theorem mustAccept_runs : mustAccept.all (fun c => (prun K0 (PS.init []) c.2).isSome) = true := by
  decide

/-- The decisions of option 2 on the checked steps of each case. -/
theorem opt2_decisions : mustAccept.map (fun c => (c.1, dec2 c.2)) =
    [("H11", [true, true, true]), ("H19", [true]), ("H29b", [true]), ("H35", []),
     ("H36", []), ("H37", [true]), ("H44", [true]), ("H45", [true, true, true, true]),
     ("H46", [true]), ("H47", [true]), ("W1", []), ("W2", [true, true]),
     ("W3", [true, true, true, true, true, true, true]), ("W3v", [true, true, true, true, true, true, true])] := by
  decide

/-- The decisions of option 3 on the checked steps of each case. -/
theorem opt3_decisions : mustAccept.map (fun c => (c.1, dec3 c.2)) =
    [("H11", [true, true, true]), ("H19", [true]), ("H29b", [true]), ("H35", []),
     ("H36", []), ("H37", [true]), ("H44", [true]), ("H45", [true, true, true, true]),
     ("H46", [true]), ("H47", [true]), ("W1", []), ("W2", [true, true]),
     ("W3", [true, true, true, true, true, true, true]), ("W3v", [true, true, true, true, true, true, true])] := by
  decide

/-- No false rejection (material §5, criterion): neither option rejects a checked step of a case that
must be accepted. -/
theorem no_false_rejection : mustAccept.all (fun c => (dec2 c.2).all id && (dec3 c.2).all id) =
    true := by
  decide

/-! ## Residual blockings (H49 to H51) -/

/-- H49 (the cycle closed through a helper then its `release`): option 2 accepts every checked step,
so the blocking of H49 remains; option 3 rejects the `store` that closes the cycle (the fourth checked
step), the helper notwithstanding. -/
theorem H49_options : dec2 h49o = [true, true, true, true] ∧
    dec3 h49o = [true, true, true, false] := by
  decide

/-- The state and the step of H49 where option 3 rejects: `store 8 6` with the helper 9 active; in
its arrival state, 7 and 8 block each other. -/
theorem H49_cycle : Blocks (storeEff (run K0 [] (h48o ++ [.derive 7 6 .modify])).s 8 6) 7 8 ∧
    Blocks (storeEff (run K0 [] (h48o ++ [.derive 7 6 .modify])).s 8 6) 8 7 :=
  by decide

/-- H50 (an authority transferred or issued into the place it covers): both options reject the
`transfer` and the `issue`, by the self-lock. -/
theorem H50_options : dec2 h50ao = [true, false] ∧ dec3 h50ao = [true, false] ∧
    dec2 h50bo = [false] ∧ dec3 h50bo = [false] := by
  decide

/-- H51 (an element of a storage owned by `v` holds a view on `v`): option 2 accepts the `store`, and
would even if it checked `store`: the view is not self-locked, the configuration being a cycle of
two authorities, which option 2 does not cover (material §5); the blocking remains. Option 3 rejects
the `store`: in its arrival state, the root of the storage, held by `v`, and the view, held by the
element, block each other. -/
theorem H51_options : dec2 h51o = [true] ∧ dec3 h51o = [false] ∧
    ¬ SelfLock (storeEff (run K0 [] (h51o.take 6)).s 4 3) 4 ∧
    Blocks (storeEff (run K0 [] (h51o.take 6)).s 4 3) 2 4 ∧
    Blocks (storeEff (run K0 [] (h51o.take 6)).s 4 3) 4 2 := by
  decide

/-! ## Cost of the check -/

/-- Locality of option 2 on `transfer`: the decision depends on the state only through the places and
the authorities held within the source, the ones the transfer moves. Two states with the same places
and the same such authorities, at the same identities, get the same decision. -/
theorem opt2_transfer_local {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hP : s'.P = s.P)
    (hA : ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), (s.A[j]? = some y ∨ s'.A[j]? = some y) →
      heldIn s.P src y.holder → s'.A[j]? = s.A[j]?) :
    Opt2Transfer s' src dst ↔ Opt2Transfer s src dst := by
  have key : ∀ (t t' : S3), t'.P = t.P →
      (∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), (t.A[j]? = some y ∨ t'.A[j]? = some y) →
        heldIn t.P src y.holder → t'.A[j]? = t.A[j]?) →
      Opt2Transfer t src dst → Opt2Transfer t' src dst := by
    intro t t' hP hA h j hj hheld hsl
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hh⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hheld
    rw [hP] at hh
    have e := hA j y (.inr hy) hh
    have hy' : t.A[j]? = some y := e.symm.trans hy
    refine h j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy')) (optP_false_iff.2 ⟨y, hy', hh⟩) ?_
    have ga : (transferEff t' src dst).A[j]? = (transferEff t src dst).A[j]? := by
      rw [transfer_A_get, transfer_A_get, e, hP]
    have gl : holderLeaves (transferEff t' src dst) = holderLeaves (transferEff t src dst) := by
      funext hd
      cases hd with
      | place p => simp only [holderLeaves, transferEff, hP]
      | frame f => rfl
    unfold SelfLock at hsl ⊢
    rw [ga, gl] at hsl
    exact hsl
  refine ⟨key s' s hP.symm (fun j y hy hh => ?_), key s s' hP hA⟩
  rw [hP] at hh
  exact (hA j y hy.symm hh).symm

/-- Option 2 on `issue` reads only the region and the destination: the block is self-locked exactly
when the destination's footprint meets the region. -/
theorem opt2_issue_local (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Opt2Issue s ar region dst ↔ ¬ ∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ footprint s.P dst := by
  unfold Opt2Issue SelfLock
  simp only [issueEff, S3.addAuth, List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_refl _), Nat.sub_self,
    List.getElem?_cons_zero, OptP, true_and, holderLeaves]

/-- The states of `opt3_not_local`: the state of H48 with the helper 9 (`Modify` on the node 6,
derived from 7), and the same run without the `store` of 7, which stays held by the frame. -/
def nl1 : PS := run K0 [] (h48o ++ [.derive 7 6 .modify])
def nl2 : PS := run K0 [] (fao ++ [.derive 6 6 .modify, .derive 5 5 .modify, .derive 7 6 .modify])

/-- Option 3 is not local to the operation: in two reached states where the kernel accepts
`store 8 6`, with the same places, the same stored authority 8 and as many authorities, the decisions
differ. The states differ by the authority 7, which the step does not touch (stored into the node 5
in the first, held by the frame in the second), and by the initialisation and anchors of the node 5,

/-! ## Preservation of `AnchorOrder` (B8, C1) -/

theorem effAnchor_mem (s : S3) (x : Nat) : s.effAnchor x = x ∨ s.effAnchor x ∈ s.ancs x :=
  List.mem_cons.1 (List.getLastD_mem_cons (l := s.ancs x) (a := x))

theorem effAnchor_le (s : S3) (x : Nat) : s.effAnchor x ≤ x := by
  rcases effAnchor_mem s x with h | h
  · exact Nat.le_of_eq h
  · exact Nat.le_of_lt (chain_lt h)

/-- The effective anchor of `x` is the element without origin of its chain (C1). -/
theorem effAnchor_eq {s : S3} : ∀ n x, x < n → ∀ r, (r = x ∨ r ∈ s.ancs x) → s.org r = none →
    s.effAnchor x = r
  | 0, _, h, _, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, x, hx, r, hr, hro => by
    rcases hr with rfl | hr
    · simp [S3.effAnchor, S3.ancs, chain_none hro]
    · cases ho : s.org x with
      | none => rw [S3.ancs, chain_none ho] at hr; simp at hr
      | some o =>
        rcases ancs_step ho with ⟨hlt, he⟩ | he
        · have e : s.effAnchor x = s.effAnchor o := by
            simp only [S3.effAnchor, he, List.getLastD_cons]
          rw [e]; rw [he] at hr
          exact effAnchor_eq n o (by omega) r (List.mem_cons.1 hr) hro
        · rw [he] at hr; simp at hr

/-- Under the order of origins of `WF3`, the effective anchor has no origin (C1, B1). -/
theorem effAnchor_root {s : S3} (hw : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y →
    y.origin = some a → a < b) (x : Nat) : s.org (s.effAnchor x) = none := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hro⟩ := reanchor_reaches_root hw (x + 1) x (Nat.lt_succ_self x)
  rw [effAnchor_eq (x + 1) x (Nat.lt_succ_self x) r hr hro]; exact hro

theorem effAnchor_congr {s s' : S3} {x : Nat} (h : s'.ancs x = s.ancs x) :
    s'.effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x := by simp only [S3.effAnchor, h]

theorem EffAnchorOK.get {s : S3} {x : Nat} {fd : Option Nat} (h : EffAnchorOK s x fd) :
    ∃ z, s.A[s.effAnchor x]? = some z := by
  unfold EffAnchorOK at h
  cases hz : s.A[s.effAnchor x]? with
  | none => rw [hz] at h; exact h.elim
  | some z => exact ⟨z, rfl⟩

/-- The effective anchor of an `EffAnchorOK` anchor has a frame. -/
theorem EffAnchorOK.frame {s : S3} {x : Nat} {fd : Option Nat} {z : Authority}
    (h : EffAnchorOK s x fd) (hz : s.A[s.effAnchor x]? = some z) :
    ∃ g, s.hframe z.holder = some g := by
  unfold EffAnchorOK at h; rw [hz] at h; simp only [OptP] at h
  cases hg : s.hframe z.holder with
  | none => rw [hg] at h; exact h.elim
  | some g => exact ⟨g, rfl⟩

/-- An `EffAnchorOK` anchor is an authority of `A`. -/
theorem EffAnchorOK.lt {s : S3} {x : Nat} {fd : Option Nat} (h : EffAnchorOK s x fd) :
    x < s.A.length := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h.get
  rcases effAnchor_mem s x with e | e
  · rw [e] at hz; exact lt_of_getElem? hz
  · have : s.org x ≠ none := fun ho => by rw [S3.ancs, chain_none ho] at e; simp at e
    simp only [S3.org] at this
    cases hx : s.A[x]? with
    | none => rw [hx] at this; exact absurd rfl this
    | some _ => exact lt_of_getElem? hx

theorem effAnchorOK_of_same {s s' : S3} {x x' : Nat} {z z' : Authority}
    (hz : s.A[s.effAnchor x]? = some z) (hz' : s'.A[s'.effAnchor x']? = some z')
    (hh : s'.hframe z'.holder = s.hframe z.holder) {fd fd' : Option Nat}
    (hanc : ∀ g f, fd = some f → (ancestor s'.F g f ↔ ancestor s.F g f)) (hfd : fd' = fd) :
    EffAnchorOK s' x' fd' ↔ EffAnchorOK s x fd := by
  rw [hfd]; unfold EffAnchorOK; rw [hz, hz']; simp only [OptP]; rw [hh]
  cases hg : s.hframe z.holder with
  | none => simp
  | some g =>
    cases hf : fd with
    | none => simp
    | some f => simp only; rw [hanc g f hf]

theorem effAnchorOK_congr {s s' : S3} (hA : s'.A = s.A) (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F)
    (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : EffAnchorOK s' x fd ↔ EffAnchorOK s x fd := by
  have ho : s'.org = s.org := funext fun i => by simp only [S3.org, hA]
  have he : s'.effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x := by unfold S3.effAnchor S3.ancs; rw [ho]
  simp only [EffAnchorOK, he, hA, hF, S3.hframe_congr hP]

/-- `AnchorOrder` carries over to a state with the same places and stack, fewer usable places,
fewer anchors, the same chains of origins, and the same holders for the existing authorities
(B8, C1). -/
theorem AnchorOrder.of {s s' : S3} (ho : AnchorOrder s) (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F)

    (hanc : ∀ a, a < s.A.length → s'.ancs a = s.ancs a)

theorem usable_of_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {l r : Nat} (h : partOf s.P l r) (hu : s.Usable l) :
    s.Usable r := by
  obtain ⟨pl, pr, hpl, hpr, ho⟩ := hw.ownerOf h
  exact hu.of_same hpl hpr ho.symm (hw.deadOf h).symm

/-- `NoDangling` carries over when no footprint grows, no usable place stops being usable, and
every active authority covers only leaves of an active authority of the previous state (C2). -/
theorem NoDangling.of {s s' : S3} (hnd : NoDangling s)
    (hfp : ∀ q l, l ∈ footprint s'.P q → l ∈ footprint s.P q)
    (hu : ∀ q, s.Usable q → s'.Usable q)
    (hA : ∀ (j : Nat) (z : Authority), s'.A[j]? = some z → z.active = true → ∀ l ∈ z.footprint,
      ∃ (i : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[i]? = some y ∧ y.active = true ∧ l ∈ y.footprint) :
    NoDangling s' := by

  obtain ⟨i, y, hy, ya, hly⟩ := hA j z hz za l hlz
  exact hnd i y hy ya q (fun h => hq (hu q h)) l (hfp q l hl) hly

/-- `derive` preserves `NoDangling` (C2; MM-03.3 §3, O1): the derived footprint is within the
footprint of the active origin. -/
theorem derive_preserves_noDangling {s s' : S3} {src q : Nat} {m : Mode} (hnd : NoDangling s)
    (h : DeriveStep src q m s (.ok s')) : NoDangling s' := by

the active origin. -/
theorem split_preserves_noDangling {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)}
    (hnd : NoDangling s) (h : SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s')) : NoDangling s' := by

-- This module serves as the root of the `Ern` library.
-- Import modules here that should be built as part of the library.
name = "ern-formal"
version = "0.1.0"

leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0

#!/bin/bash
# usage: axcheck.sh Module.Name [Module.Name ...]   (run after lake build of those modules)
SP=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guygouri-Devlab-ernlang-ern/c986905c-e900-4fd9-bebc-4a3ce7ebb180/scratchpad/ref
F=$SP/axcheck_$$.lean
{
  echo "import Lean"
  for m in "$@"; do echo "import $m"; done
  echo 'open Lean Elab Command in'
  echo '#eval show Lean.Core.CoreM Unit from do'
  echo '  let env ← getEnv'
  printf '  for modName in [%s] do\n' "$(printf '`%s, ' "$@" | sed 's/, $//')"
  cat <<'L'
    let some mod := env.getModuleIdx? modName | throwError "no module"
    let mut all := 0
    let mut thms := 0
    let mut bad : Array (Name × Array Name) := #[]
    for (n, ci) in env.constants.map₁.toList do
      if env.getModuleIdxFor? n == some mod then
        all := all + 1
        if let .thmInfo _ := ci then thms := thms + 1
        let axs ← collectAxioms n
        let extra := axs.filter fun a => a != ``propext && a != ``Quot.sound
        if !extra.isEmpty then bad := bad.push (n, extra)
    IO.println s!"{modName}: constants {all}, theorems {thms}"
    IO.println s!"outside propext, Quot.sound: {bad}"
L
} > $F
cd /Users/guygouri/Devlab/ernlang/ern/formal && ~/.elan/bin/lake env lean $F
rm -f $F

18	/-- A chain from an element without link is empty (§40 parents, §42 origins). -/
19	theorem chainF_none {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i : Nat} (h : org i = none) :
20	    ∀ k, chainF org k i = []
21	  | 0 => rfl
22	  | _ + 1 => by simp [chainF, h]

27	  | 0, 0, _, _, _ => rfl
28	  | 0, _ + 1, i, h, _ => by
29	    obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
30	    simp only [chainF]; split <;> simp

33	    simp only [chainF]; split <;> simp

35	    simp only [chainF]; split
36	    · split

39	    · rfl

42	theorem chain_none {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i : Nat} (h : org i = none) : chain org i = [] :=
43	  chainF_none h i
44

46	theorem chain_cons {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i o : Nat} (h : org i = some o) (hlt : o < i) :
47	    chain org i = o :: chain org o := by
48	  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, i = k + 1 := ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩
49	  simp only [chain, chainF, h, hlt, ↓reduceIte]
50	  rw [chainF_fuel org k o o (by omega) (Nat.le_refl o)]

55	  | k + 1, i, j, h => by
56	    simp only [chainF] at h; split at h
57	    · split at h
58	      · rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
59	        · assumption
60	        · exact Nat.lt_trans (chainF_lt k _ j h) ‹_›
61	      · simp at h
62	    · simp at h

98	authorities). -/
99	theorem chainF_root {org : Nat → Option Nat} : ∀ k i r r', r ∈ chainF org k i → org r = none →
100	    r' ∈ chainF org k i → org r' = none → r = r'
101	  | 0, _, _, _, h, _, _, _ => by simp [chainF] at h
102	  | k + 1, i, r, r', h, hr, h', hr' => by
103	    simp only [chainF] at h h'; split at h
104	    · rename_i o ho; simp only [ho] at h'
105	      split at h
106	      · rename_i hlt; simp only [hlt, ↓reduceIte] at h'
107	        rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h <;> rcases List.mem_cons.1 h' with rfl | h'
108	        · rfl
109	        · rw [chainF_none hr] at h'; simp at h'
110	        · rw [chainF_none hr'] at h; simp at h
111	        · exact chainF_root k _ r r' h hr h' hr'
112	      · simp at h
113	    · simp at h

115	/-- A chain contains the chain of each of its elements, for links to smaller indices (§40, §42,
116	§49). -/
117	theorem chain_trans {org : Nat → Option Nat} (hlt : ∀ i o, org i = some o → o < i) :
118	    ∀ n i, i < n → ∀ r, r ∈ chain org i → ∀ o ∈ chain org r, o ∈ chain org i
119	  | 0, _, h, _, _, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
120	  | n + 1, i, hi, r, hr, o, ho => by
121	    cases hp : org i with
122	    | none => rw [chain_none hp] at hr; simp at hr
123	    | some p =>
124	      have hpi := hlt i p hp
125	      rw [chain_cons hp hpi] at hr ⊢
126	      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hr with rfl | hr
127	      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ho
128	      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (chain_trans hlt n p (by omega) r hr o ho)

132	/-- Membership in `footprint(q)` (§40): an existing leaf that is a part of `q`. -/
133	theorem mem_footprint {P : List Place} {q l : Nat} :
134	    l ∈ footprint P q ↔ l < P.length ∧ isLeaf P l ∧ partOf P l q := by
135	  simp [footprint, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range]

137	/-- Footprints depend only on the number of places and on structural parents (§40). -/
138	theorem footprint_congr {P P' : List Place} (hlen : P'.length = P.length)
139	    (hpar : parentOf P' = parentOf P) (q : Nat) : footprint P' q = footprint P q := by
140	  unfold footprint; rw [hlen]; congr 1; funext l
141	  exact decide_eq_decide.2 (by simp only [isLeaf, partOf, hpar, hlen])

143	/-- The frame of a place is unique (§40, `placeFrame`). -/
144	theorem FrameOf.det {s : S3} {q f f' : Nat} (h : FrameOf s q f) (h' : FrameOf s q f') :
145	    f = f' := by
146	  induction h generalizing f' with
147	  | frame hpl ho => cases h' with
148	    | frame hpl' ho' => rw [hpl] at hpl'; cases hpl'; rw [ho] at ho'; cases ho'; rfl
149	    | place hpl' ho' _ => rw [hpl] at hpl'; cases hpl'; rw [ho] at ho'; cases ho'
150	  | place hpl ho _ ih => cases h' with
151	    | frame hpl' ho' => rw [hpl] at hpl'; cases hpl'; rw [ho] at ho'; cases ho'
152	    | place hpl' ho' hf' => rw [hpl] at hpl'; cases hpl'; rw [ho] at ho'; cases ho'; exact ih hf'
153	
154	/-- A usable place has a frame of the stack (§40, items 2–3). -/
155	theorem S3.Usable.frameOf {s : S3} {q : Nat} (h : s.Usable q) : ∃ f, FrameOf s q f ∧ f ∈ s.F := by
156	  induction h with
157	  | frame hpl _ ho hf => exact ⟨_, .frame hpl ho, hf⟩
158	  | place hpl _ ho _ ih => obtain ⟨f, hf, hm⟩ := ih; exact ⟨f, .place hpl ho hf, hm⟩

160	/-- The frame of a place depends only on the places (§40, `placeFrame`). -/
161	theorem FrameOf.congr {s s' : S3} (hP : s'.P = s.P) {q f : Nat} :
162	    FrameOf s' q f ↔ FrameOf s q f :=
163	  ⟨fun h => by induction h with
164	    | frame hpl ho => exact .frame (hP ▸ hpl) ho
165	    | place hpl ho _ ih => exact .place (hP ▸ hpl) ho ih,
166	   fun h => by induction h with
167	    | frame hpl ho => exact .frame (hP ▸ hpl) ho
168	    | place hpl ho _ ih => exact .place (hP ▸ hpl) ho ih⟩

171	theorem S3.pframe_congr {s s' : S3} (hP : s'.P = s.P) (q : Nat) : s'.pframe q = s.pframe q :=
172	  Option.ext fun f => by rw [pframe_iff, pframe_iff, FrameOf.congr hP]

175	theorem S3.hframe_congr {s s' : S3} (hP : s'.P = s.P) (h : Holder) :
176	    s'.hframe h = s.hframe h := by
177	  cases h with
178	  | frame f => rfl
179	  | place p => exact S3.pframe_congr hP p

182	theorem pframe_eq_of_owner {s : S3} {q r : Nat} {pq pr : Place} (hq : s.P[q]? = some pq)
183	    (hr : s.P[r]? = some pr) (h : pr.owner = pq.owner) : s.pframe r = s.pframe q := by
184	  simp only [S3.pframe, pframeF, hq, hr, h]

188	/-- `mapI` preserves the length (effects of §72 and §73). -/
189	theorem length_mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) :
190	    ∀ (i : Nat) (l : List α), (mapI f i l).length = l.length
191	  | _, [] => rfl
192	  | i, _ :: l => by simp [mapI, length_mapI f (i + 1) l]

194	/-- Element `j` of `mapI f i l` is `f (i + j)` applied to element `j` of `l` (effects of §72 and
195	§73). -/
196	theorem getElem?_mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) :
197	    ∀ (i : Nat) (l : List α) (j : Nat), (mapI f i l)[j]? = (l[j]?).map (f (i + j))
198	  | _, [], _ => rfl
199	  | i, a :: l, 0 => by simp [mapI]
200	  | i, a :: l, j + 1 => by

208	    (h₁ : Guarded Pre eff o₁) (h₂ : Guarded Pre eff o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by

214	    Guarded Pre eff (.ok s') ↔ Pre ∧ s' = eff :=
215	  ⟨fun h => by cases h; exact ⟨‹_›, rfl⟩, fun ⟨h, e⟩ => e ▸ .ok h⟩

218	theorem Guarded.reject_iff {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff : σ} :

222	/-! ## Effective modes (§43) -/
223	
224	/-- Cases 2 and 4 of §43: a present effective mode is the own mode when no active descendant
225	covers the leaf, `Observe` when only `Observe` descendants do. -/
226	theorem effOf_cases {m m' : Mode} {ds : List Mode} (h : effOf m ds = some m') :
227	    (ds = [] ∧ m' = m) ∨ (ds ≠ [] ∧ Mode.modify ∉ ds ∧ m' = .observe) := by
228	  unfold effOf at h
229	  by_cases h0 : ds = []
230	  · simp [h0] at h; exact .inl ⟨h0, h.symm⟩
231	  · by_cases h1 : Mode.modify ∈ ds
232	    · simp [h0, h1] at h
233	    · simp [h0, h1] at h; exact .inr ⟨h0, h1, h.symm⟩
234	
235	/-- A mode other than `Modify` is `Observe` (§42). -/
236	theorem mode_eq_observe {m : Mode} (h : m ≠ .modify) : m = .observe := by cases m <;> simp_all
237	
238	/-- Membership in `descModes` (§43): the mode of an active descendant covering the leaf. -/
239	theorem mem_descModes {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {m : Mode} :
240	    m ∈ descModes s a p ↔ ∃ j y, s.A[j]? = some y ∧ y.active = true ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧
241	      a ∈ s.ancs j ∧ y.mode = m := by
242	  simp only [descModes, List.mem_filterMap, List.mem_range]
243	  constructor
244	  · rintro ⟨j, -, h⟩
245	    split at h
246	    · rename_i y hy
247	      split at h
248	      · rename_i hc; cases h; exact ⟨j, y, hy, hc.1, hc.2.1, hc.2.2, rfl⟩
249	      · cases h
250	    · cases h
251	  · rintro ⟨j, y, hy, h1, h2, h3, rfl⟩
252	    refine ⟨j, (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 hy).1, ?_⟩
253	    simp [hy, h1, h2, h3]
254	
255	/-- A present effective mode (§43, case 1): the authority is active and covers the leaf. -/
256	theorem effective_some {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {m : Mode} (h : effective s a p = some m) :
257	    ∃ x, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ x.active = true ∧ p ∈ x.footprint ∧
258	      effOf x.mode (descModes s a p) = some m := by
259	  unfold effective at h
260	  split at h
261	  · rename_i x hx; split at h
262	    · rename_i hc; exact ⟨x, hx, hc.1, hc.2, h⟩
263	    · cases h
264	  · cases h

266	/-- The effective mode of an active authority covering the leaf (§43, cases 2–4). -/
267	theorem effective_eq {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {x : Authority} (hx : s.A[a]? = some x)
268	    (ha : x.active = true) (hp : p ∈ x.footprint) :
269	    effective s a p = effOf x.mode (descModes s a p) := by
270	  simp [effective, hx, ha, hp]

272	/-- The mode order is reflexive (§43). -/
273	theorem Mode.le_refl (m : Mode) : m.le m := by cases m <;> simp [Mode.le]
274	
275	/-- The effective mode does not exceed the own mode (§43). -/
276	theorem effective_le {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {m : Mode} {x : Authority} (hx : s.A[a]? = some x)
277	    (h : effective s a p = some m) : m.le x.mode := by
278	  obtain ⟨x', hx', -, -, he⟩ := effective_some h
279	  rw [hx] at hx'; cases hx'
280	  rcases effOf_cases he with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, -, rfl⟩
281	  · exact Mode.le_refl _
282	  · simp [Mode.le]
283	
284	/-- The mode order is transitive (§43). -/
285	theorem Mode.le_trans {a b c : Mode} (h₁ : a.le b) (h₂ : b.le c) : a.le c := by
286	  cases a <;> cases b <;> cases c <;> simp_all [Mode.le]
287	
288	/-- Only `Observe` is below `Observe` (§43). -/
289	theorem Mode.le_observe {m : Mode} (h : m.le .observe) : m = .observe := by
290	  cases m <;> simp_all [Mode.le]
291	
292	/-- A mode permitted by a present effective mode (§43): below the own mode when no active
293	descendant covers the leaf, `Observe` when no `Modify` descendant does. -/
294	theorem allows_effOf {m m' : Mode} {ds : List Mode} (h : Allows (effOf m ds) m') :
295	    (ds = [] ∧ m'.le m) ∨ (Mode.modify ∉ ds ∧ m' = .observe) := by
296	  unfold Allows OptP at h
297	  split at h
298	  · rename_i e he
299	    rcases effOf_cases he with ⟨h0, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, hn, rfl⟩
300	    · exact .inl ⟨h0, h⟩
301	    · exact .inr ⟨hn, Mode.le_observe h⟩
302	  · exact h.elim

304	/-! ## Consequences of `I1` (§50) -/
305	
306	/-- Under `I1`, two distinct authorities with present effective modes on a leaf have compatible
307	effective modes, `Observe`/`Observe` (§50, second paragraph). -/
308	theorem effective_compat {s : S3} (h : I1 s) :
309	    ∀ a b p m₁ m₂, a ≠ b → effective s a p = some m₁ → effective s b p = some m₂ →
310	      Compat m₁ m₂ := by
311	  intro a b p m₁ m₂ hab ha hb
312	  obtain ⟨x, hx, xa, xp, ex⟩ := effective_some ha
313	  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya, yp, ey⟩ := effective_some hb
314	  have obs₁ : x.mode = .observe → m₁ = .observe := fun hm => by
315	    rcases effOf_cases ex with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ <;> simp [hm]
316	  have obs₂ : y.mode = .observe → m₂ = .observe := fun hm => by
317	    rcases effOf_cases ey with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ <;> simp [hm]
318	  by_cases hba : b ∈ s.ancs a
319	  · have hm : x.mode ∈ descModes s b p := mem_descModes.2 ⟨a, x, hx, xa, xp, hba, rfl⟩
320	    rcases effOf_cases ey with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨-, hn, rfl⟩
321	    · simp [h0] at hm
322	    · have : x.mode = .observe := mode_eq_observe fun e => hn (e ▸ hm)
323	      exact ⟨obs₁ this, rfl⟩
324	  by_cases hab' : a ∈ s.ancs b
325	  · have hm : y.mode ∈ descModes s a p := mem_descModes.2 ⟨b, y, hy, ya, yp, hab', rfl⟩
326	    rcases effOf_cases ex with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨-, hn, rfl⟩
327	    · simp [h0] at hm
328	    · have : y.mode = .observe := mode_eq_observe fun e => hn (e ▸ hm)
329	      exact ⟨rfl, obs₂ this⟩
330	  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h a b x y p hab hx hy xa ya xp yp hab' hba
331	  exact ⟨obs₁ h₁, obs₂ h₂⟩

333	/-- `effective_exclusive` (§50): under `I1`, an authority with effective `Modify` on a leaf is the
334	only one with a present effective mode there. -/
335	theorem effective_exclusive {s : S3} (h : I1 s) {a b p : Nat} (hab : a ≠ b)
336	    (ha : effective s a p = some .modify) : effective s b p = none := by
337	  cases hb : effective s b p with
338	  | none => rfl
339	  | some m => exact absurd (effective_compat h a b p _ _ hab ha hb).1 (by simp)

341	/-- Compatibility of effective modes is symmetric (§50). -/
342	theorem Compat.symm {m₁ m₂ : Mode} (h : Compat m₁ m₂) : Compat m₂ m₁ := ⟨h.2, h.1⟩

344	/-- `I4` holds in every state (§53, first sentence): a read requires `Init` on every leaf read

350	/-- A list whose members are none is empty (§43, §63.2). -/
351	theorem nil_of_forall_not_mem {α : Type} : ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ a, a ∉ l) → l = []
352	  | [], _ => rfl
353	  | a :: _, h => absurd (List.mem_cons_self ..) (h a)

355	/-- `filterMap` depends only on the values of the function on the list (§43, `descModes`). -/
356	theorem filterMap_congr' {α β : Type} {f g : α → Option β} :
357	    ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ a ∈ l, f a = g a) → l.filterMap f = l.filterMap g
358	  | [], _ => rfl
359	  | a :: l, h => by
360	    simp only [List.filterMap_cons, h a (List.mem_cons_self ..),
361	      filterMap_congr' fun b hb => h b (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hb)]

363	/-- The authorities after an addition: the former ones, and the new one at the fresh identity
364	(§42, fresh identities). -/
365	theorem addAuth_get {s : S3} {y₀ z : Authority} {j : Nat} (h : (s.addAuth y₀).A[j]? = some z) :
366	    (j < s.A.length ∧ s.A[j]? = some z) ∨ (j = s.A.length ∧ z = y₀) := by

368	  by_cases hj : j < s.A.length
369	  · exact .inl ⟨hj, by rwa [List.getElem?_append_left hj] at h⟩
370	  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)] at h
371	    have : j - s.A.length = 0 := by
372	      have := lt_of_getElem? h; simp at this; omega
373	    rw [this] at h; simp at h
374	    exact .inr ⟨by have := lt_of_getElem? (l := s.A ++ [y₀]) (i := j) (x := z) (by
375	      rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega), this]; simp [h]); simp at this; omega, h.symm⟩

382	theorem addAuth_self (s : S3) (y₀ : Authority) : (s.addAuth y₀).A[s.A.length]? = some y₀ := by

385	/-- An addition keeps the origin chains of the former authorities (§42). -/
386	theorem ancs_addAuth_lt {s : S3} {y₀ : Authority} {j : Nat} (h : j < s.A.length) :
387	    (s.addAuth y₀).ancs j = s.ancs j :=
388	  chain_congr fun i hi => by simp only [S3.org, addAuth_lt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hi h)]

390	/-- The origin chain of an authority added with origin `src` is `src` followed by the chain of
391	`src` (§42, §60). -/
392	theorem ancs_addAuth_self {s : S3} {y₀ : Authority} {src : Nat} (ho : y₀.origin = some src)
393	    (hs : src < s.A.length) : (s.addAuth y₀).ancs s.A.length = src :: s.ancs src := by
394	  unfold S3.ancs
395	  rw [chain_cons (by simp [S3.org, addAuth_self, ho]) hs]
396	  exact congrArg _ (ancs_addAuth_lt hs)

398	/-- An addition keeps active authorities active (§42). -/
399	theorem active_addAuth {s : S3} {y₀ : Authority} {x : Nat} (h : s.Active x) :
400	    (s.addAuth y₀).Active x := by
401	  obtain ⟨y, hy, ha⟩ := h; exact ⟨y, by rw [addAuth_lt (lt_of_getElem? hy)]; exact hy, ha⟩

403	/-- The covering descendants after an addition: the former ones, and the new authority when it
404	is an active descendant covering the leaf (§43). -/
405	theorem descModes_addAuth (s : S3) (y₀ : Authority) (a p : Nat) :
406	    descModes (s.addAuth y₀) a p = descModes s a p ++
407	      (if y₀.active = true ∧ p ∈ y₀.footprint ∧ a ∈ (s.addAuth y₀).ancs s.A.length
408	        then [y₀.mode] else []) := by
409	  have hl : (s.addAuth y₀).A.length = s.A.length + 1 := by simp [S3.addAuth]
410	  unfold descModes
411	  rw [hl, List.range_succ, List.filterMap_append]
412	  congr 1
413	  · refine filterMap_congr' fun j hj => ?_
414	    have hj' := List.mem_range.1 hj
415	    rw [addAuth_lt hj', ancs_addAuth_lt hj']
416	  · simp only [List.filterMap_cons, List.filterMap_nil, addAuth_self]
417	    split <;> simp_all

419	/-- An addition leaves the effective mode of a former authority unchanged on a leaf the new
420	authority does not cover (§43). -/
421	theorem effective_addAuth_notin {s : S3} {y₀ : Authority} {a p : Nat} (ha : a < s.A.length)
422	    (hp : p ∉ y₀.footprint) : effective (s.addAuth y₀) a p = effective s a p := by
423	  unfold effective; rw [addAuth_lt ha, descModes_addAuth]; simp [hp]

425	/-- Under `I1`, an authority derived from `src` with a mode permitted on leaf `p`, and an active
426	authority covering `p` outside the origin chain of the new one, are both `Observe` (§50, §60.3). -/
427	theorem new_vs_old {s : S3} (ht : I1 s) {src b p : Nat} {x y : Authority} {m : Mode}
428	    (hx : s.A[src]? = some x) (xa : x.active = true) (xp : p ∈ x.footprint)
429	    (hal : Allows (effective s src p) m) (hy : s.A[b]? = some y) (ya : y.active = true)
430	    (yp : p ∈ y.footprint) (hbs : b ≠ src) (hbn : b ∉ s.ancs src) :
431	    m = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe := by
432	  rw [effective_eq hx xa xp] at hal
433	  by_cases hsb : src ∈ s.ancs b
434	  · have hm : y.mode ∈ descModes s src p := mem_descModes.2 ⟨b, y, hy, ya, yp, hsb, rfl⟩
435	    rcases allows_effOf hal with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨hn, rfl⟩
436	    · simp [h0] at hm
437	    · exact ⟨rfl, mode_eq_observe fun e => hn (e ▸ hm)⟩
438	  · obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := ht src b x y p (Ne.symm hbs) hx hy xa ya xp yp hsb hbn
439	    rcases allows_effOf hal with ⟨-, hl⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩
440	    · exact ⟨Mode.le_observe (h₁ ▸ hl), h₂⟩
441	    · exact ⟨rfl, h₂⟩

443	/-- `split` adds its authorities one region at a time (§61, `ok` effect). -/
444	theorem splitEff_cons (s : S3) (src : Nat) (r : List Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) :
