446	      splitEff (s.addAuth ⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩) src rs := by
447	  simp [splitEff, S3.addAuth, S3.top]
448	
449	/-! ## Same authorities up to holders (§42, §63) -/
450	
451	/-- Skeleton of an authority (§42): every field but its holder. -/
452	def skel (z : Authority) : Mode × Option Nat × List Nat × Bool :=
453	  (z.mode, z.origin, z.footprint, z.active)
454	
455	/-- `s'` has the authorities of `s` up to their holders (§42; §63: a transfer creates and
456	duplicates no authority). -/
457	def SameSkel (s s' : S3) : Prop :=
458	  s'.A.length = s.A.length ∧ ∀ j : Nat, (s'.A[j]?).map skel = (s.A[j]?).map skel
459	
460	/-- An authority of `s'` has a counterpart in `s` with the same skeleton (§42). -/
461	theorem SameSkel.get {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') {j : Nat} {y' : Authority}
462	    (hj : s'.A[j]? = some y') : ∃ y, s.A[j]? = some y ∧ skel y' = skel y := by
463	  have := h.2 j; rw [hj] at this
464	  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
465	  | none => rw [hy] at this; cases this
466	  | some y => rw [hy] at this; exact ⟨y, rfl, Option.some.inj this⟩
467	
468	/-- An authority of `s` has a counterpart in `s'` with the same skeleton (§42). -/
469	theorem SameSkel.get' {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') {j : Nat} {y : Authority}
470	    (hj : s.A[j]? = some y) : ∃ y', s'.A[j]? = some y' ∧ skel y' = skel y := by
471	  have := h.2 j; rw [hj] at this
472	  cases hy : s'.A[j]? with
473	  | none => rw [hy] at this; cases this
474	  | some y' => rw [hy] at this; exact ⟨y', rfl, Option.some.inj this⟩
475	
476	/-- Same skeletons give the same origin links (§42). -/
477	theorem SameSkel.org {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') : s'.org = s.org := by
478	  funext j
479	  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
480	  | none =>
481	    cases hy' : s'.A[j]? with
482	    | none => simp [S3.org, hy, hy']
483	    | some y' => obtain ⟨y, h1, -⟩ := h.get hy'; rw [hy] at h1; cases h1
484	  | some y => obtain ⟨y', hy', e⟩ := h.get' hy; simp [skel] at e; simp [S3.org, hy, hy', e.2.1]
485	
486	/-- Same skeletons give the same origin chains (§42). -/
487	theorem SameSkel.ancs {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') : s'.ancs = s.ancs := by
488	  funext j; simp [S3.ancs, h.org]
489	
490	/-- Same skeletons give the same active authorities (§42). -/
491	theorem SameSkel.active {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') {x : Nat} :
492	    s'.Active x ↔ s.Active x := by
493	  constructor
494	  · rintro ⟨y', hy', ha⟩; obtain ⟨y, hy, he⟩ := h.get hy'
495	    exact ⟨y, hy, by simp [skel] at he; rw [← he.2.2.2]; exact ha⟩
496	  · rintro ⟨y, hy, ha⟩; obtain ⟨y', hy', he⟩ := h.get' hy
497	    exact ⟨y', hy', by simp [skel] at he; rw [he.2.2.2]; exact ha⟩
498	
499	/-- Same skeletons give the same covering descendants (§43). -/
500	theorem SameSkel.descModes {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (a p : Nat) :
501	    descModes s' a p = descModes s a p := by
502	  unfold Access.descModes; rw [h.1, h.ancs]
503	  refine filterMap_congr' fun j _ => ?_
504	  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
505	  | none => have := h.2 j; rw [hy] at this; cases hy' : s'.A[j]? <;> simp_all
506	  | some y =>
507	    obtain ⟨y', hy', he⟩ := h.get' hy
508	    simp [skel] at he; simp [hy', he]
509	
510	/-- Same skeletons give the same effective modes (§43). -/
511	theorem SameSkel.effective {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (a p : Nat) :
512	    effective s' a p = effective s a p := by
513	  unfold Access.effective; rw [h.descModes]
514	  cases hy : s.A[a]? with
515	  | none => have := h.2 a; rw [hy] at this; cases hy' : s'.A[a]? <;> simp_all
516	  | some y =>
517	    obtain ⟨y', hy', he⟩ := h.get' hy
518	    simp [skel] at he; simp [hy', he]
519	
520	/-- `I1` depends only on the skeletons (§50). -/
521	theorem SameSkel.i1 {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (h1 : I1 s) : I1 s' := by
522	  intro a b x' y' p hab ha hb xa ya xp yp hnab hnba
523	  obtain ⟨x, hx, ex⟩ := h.get ha; obtain ⟨y, hy, ey⟩ := h.get hb
524	  simp [skel] at ex ey; rw [h.ancs] at hnab hnba
525	  rw [ex.1, ey.1]
526	  exact h1 a b x y p hab hx hy (ex.2.2.2 ▸ xa) (ey.2.2.2 ▸ ya) (ex.2.2.1 ▸ xp) (ey.2.2.1 ▸ yp)
527	    hnab hnba
528	
529	/-- `I2` depends only on the skeletons (§51). -/
530	theorem SameSkel.i2 {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (h2 : I2 s) : I2 s' := by
531	  intro b y a hb ho
532	  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := h.get hb; simp [skel] at e
533	  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hm, hh⟩ := h2 b y₀ a hy₀ (e.2.1 ▸ ho)
534	  obtain ⟨x', hx', e'⟩ := h.get' hx₀; simp [skel] at e'
535	  exact ⟨x', hx', by rw [e.1, e'.1]; exact hm,
536	    fun p hp => by rw [e'.2.2.1]; exact hh p (e.2.2.1 ▸ hp)⟩
537	
538	/-- The origin clause of `WF3` depends only on the skeletons (§49.5). -/
539	theorem SameSkel.origins {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s')
540	    (hw : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b) :
541	    ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s'.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b := by
542	  intro b y a hb ho
543	  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := h.get hb; simp [skel] at e
544	  exact hw b y₀ a hy₀ (e.2.1 ▸ ho)
545	
546	/-- A property of every footprint member depends only on the skeletons (§49.4). -/
547	theorem SameSkel.footprints {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') {Q : Nat → Prop}
548	    (hw : ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint, Q l) :
549	    ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s'.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint, Q l := by
550	  intro a x hx l hl
551	  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, e⟩ := h.get hx; simp [skel] at e
552	  exact hw a x₀ hx₀ l (e.2.2.1 ▸ hl)
553	
554	/-! ## `release` (§62) -/
555	
556	/-- Element `j` after setting element `a` (§62, §65 effects). -/
557	theorem set_get {l : List Authority} {a j : Nat} {x' : Authority} (ha : a < l.length) :
558	    (l.set a x')[j]? = if a = j then some x' else l[j]? := by
559	  rw [List.getElem?_set]; split <;> simp_all
560	
561	/-- The effect of `release` on an existing authority (§62, `ok` effect). -/
562	theorem releaseEff_eq {s : S3} {a : Nat} {x : Authority} (hx : s.A[a]? = some x) :
563	    releaseEff s a = { s with
564	      A := s.A.set a { x with active := false }
565	      D := fun q => if x.holder = .place q then (s.D q).filter (· != a) else s.D q } := by
566	  simp [releaseEff, hx]
567	
568	/-- The anchors after a release: those before, without `a` at the place holding it (§62, `ok`
569	effect). -/
570	theorem release_D_mem {s : S3} {a q y : Nat} {x : Authority} (hx : s.A[a]? = some x)
571	    (hy : y ∈ (releaseEff s a).D q) : y ∈ s.D q ∧ (y = a → x.holder ≠ .place q) := by
572	  rw [releaseEff_eq hx] at hy; simp only at hy
573	  split at hy
574	  · rename_i hh
575	    obtain ⟨hy, hne⟩ := List.mem_filter.1 hy
576	    exact ⟨hy, fun e => by subst e; simp at hne⟩
577	  · exact ⟨hy, fun _ => ‹_›⟩
578	
579	/-- A release keeps the origin links (§62). -/
580	theorem release_org {s : S3} {a : Nat} {x : Authority} (hx : s.A[a]? = some x) :
581	    (releaseEff s a).org = s.org := by
582	  funext j; rw [releaseEff_eq hx]
583	  simp only [S3.org, set_get (lt_of_getElem? hx)]
584	  split
585	  · subst_vars; simp [hx]
586	  · rfl
587	
588	/-- A release keeps the origin chains (§62). -/
589	theorem release_ancs {s : S3} {a : Nat} {x : Authority} (hx : s.A[a]? = some x) :
590	    (releaseEff s a).ancs = s.ancs := by

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.Common

/-!
# Access kernel: `transfer` (O4, §63)

Properties of `transfer` (§63) and its preservation of the kernel invariant `KInv` (§57) with
`KAux`.

* §63 as written does not preserve `KInv`: `transfer_breaks_kinv` is a reachable state where an
  accepted transfer closes an ownership cycle, breaking holder validity (§49.8) and `NoDangling`
  (§54).
* With the destination usable in the resulting state (an extra hypothesis, not a clause of §63),
  `WF3`, `Inv3`, `NoOrphan` and `KAux` are preserved (`transfer_preserves_wf3_inv3_of_dst_usable`),
  but `AnchorOrderHeld` is not: §63.7 constrains only the moved held authorities, and an authority
  held outside the value whose effective anchor moves with it escapes the check
  (`transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable_fails`, on a state that is not built by kernel steps).
  With the further hypothesis `HeldAnchored` (also not a clause of the spec), `KInv` and `KAux`
  are preserved (`transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable_of_heldAnchored`).
* The effect and rejection theorems of §63.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Helpers on options and stacks -/

/-- Reading `OptP` with default `True` on a present value (§38). -/
private theorem optP_true {α : Type} {o : Option α} {P : α → Prop} {y : α} (h : OptP o P True)
    (hy : o = some y) : P y := by
  subst hy; exact h

/-- `OptP` with default `False` holds on a present value (§38). -/
private theorem optP_false_iff {α : Type} {o : Option α} {P : α → Prop} :
    OptP o P False ↔ ∃ y, o = some y ∧ P y := by
  cases o with
  | none => exact ⟨fun h => h.elim, fun ⟨_, h, _⟩ => by cases h⟩
  | some y => exact ⟨fun h => ⟨y, rfl, h⟩, fun ⟨_, h, hy⟩ => by cases h; exact hy⟩

/-- A frame of the stack is its own ancestor (§39). -/
private theorem ancestor_self {F : Frames} {f : Nat} (h : f ∈ F) : ancestor F f f := by
  unfold ancestor
  induction F with
  | nil => cases h
  | cons g F ih =>
    rw [List.dropWhile_cons]
    by_cases e : g = f
    · subst e; simp
    · have hne : (g != f) = true := by simp [e]
      simp only [hne, ↓reduceIte]
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
      · exact absurd rfl e
      · exact ih h

/-- In a duplicate-free stack `f :: F₀`, a frame of `F₀` does not have `f` as an ancestor (§39,
§49.1). -/
private theorem not_ancestor_top {f g : Nat} {F₀ : Frames} (hnd : (f :: F₀).Nodup) (hg : g ∈ F₀) :
    ¬ ancestor (f :: F₀) f g := by
  have hn := List.nodup_cons.1 hnd
  have hfg : f ≠ g := fun e => hn.1 (e ▸ hg)
  unfold ancestor
  simp only [List.dropWhile_cons, show (f != g) = true by simp [hfg], ↓reduceIte]
  exact fun h => hn.1 (mem_of_mem_dropWhile h)

/-! ## Bounded form of `KInv ∧ KAux` (§49, §50–§54, §57)

Every quantifier of `KInv ∧ KAux` bounded by the indices of `P` and `A`, so that `decide` checks
it on a concrete state. Used only by the counterexamples below. -/

/-- Owner validity of §49.3 for one place (bounded form). -/
private def OwnerOK (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .frame f => f < s.nF
  | .place o => o < s.P.length

/-- Decidability of `OwnerOK` (§49.3). -/
private instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (OwnerOK s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold OwnerOK <;> infer_instance

/-- `KInv ∧ KAux` (§57, §49.7) with every quantifier bounded. -/
private def KInvB (s : S3) : Prop :=
  (s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OptP (s.P[q]?) (fun pl => OptP pl.parent (fun r =>
    OptP (s.P[r]?) (fun pr => r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q) False) True)
    True) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OptP (s.P[q]?) (fun pl => OwnerOK s pl.owner) True) ∧
  (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun x =>
    ∀ l ∈ x.footprint, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l) True) ∧
  (∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => OptP y.origin (fun a => a < b) True)
    True) ∧
  (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => ∀ l ∈ y.footprint, isLeaf s.P l →
    ∃ x ∈ a :: s.ancs a, OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun z => z.origin = none ∧
      ∃ r ∈ List.range s.P.length, RootPlace s.P r ∧ partOf s.P l r ∧
        (∀ l' ∈ z.footprint, l' ∈ footprint s.P r) ∧ ∀ l' ∈ footprint s.P r, l' ∈ z.footprint)
      False) True) ∧
  (∀ r ∈ List.range s.P.length, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r →
    ∃ i ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[i]?) (fun z => z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧
      z.mode = .modify ∧ OptP (s.P[r]?) (fun pr => z.holder = pr.owner) False ∧
      (∀ l ∈ z.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P r) ∧ ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P r, l ∈ z.footprint) False) ∧
  (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
    HolderLive s y.holder) True) ∧
  (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ≠ b →
    OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun x => OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => x.active = true → y.active = true →
      (∃ p ∈ x.footprint, p ∈ y.footprint) → a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a →
      x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe) True) True) ∧
  (∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => OptP y.origin (fun a =>
    OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun x => y.mode.le x.mode ∧ ∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint) False) True)
    True) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x) ∧
  AnchorOrder s ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ¬ s.Usable q → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint) True) ∧
  AnchorOrderHeld s ∧
  (∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun z => z.origin = none →
    ∀ l ∈ z.footprint, ∀ r ∈ List.range s.P.length, RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r →
      OptP (s.P[r]?) (fun pr => z.holder = pr.owner) False) True)

/-- Decidability of `KInvB` (§57). -/
private instance (s : S3) : Decidable (KInvB s) := by unfold KInvB; infer_instance

/-- A place of a footprint is a place of the state (§40). -/
private theorem lt_of_mem_footprint {P : List Place} {q l : Nat} (h : l ∈ footprint P q) :
    q < P.length := by
  obtain ⟨hl, -, -, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 h
  rcases hlq with rfl | hc
  · exact hl
  · exact Nat.lt_trans (chain_lt hc) hl

/-- The bounded form gives `KInv ∧ KAux` (§57, §49.7). -/
private theorem kInvAux_of_bounded {s : S3} (h : KInvB s) : KInv s ∧ KAux s := by
  obtain ⟨hF, hpl, hown, hfp, hor, hrc, hrh, hho, h1, h2, h3, hao, hnd, haoh, hconv⟩ := h
  have wf : WF3 s := {
    frames := hF
    places := fun q pl r hq hp => by
      have := optP_true (optP_true (hpl q (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hq))) hq) hp
      obtain ⟨pr, hpr, h⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 this
      exact ⟨pr, hpr, h⟩
    owners := ⟨fun q pl f hq ho => by
        have := optP_true (hown q (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hq))) hq
        rw [ho] at this; exact this,
      fun q pl o hq ho => by
        have := optP_true (hown q (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hq))) hq
        rw [ho] at this; exact this,
      fun q hq => hq.frameOf⟩
    footprints := fun a x hx => optP_true (hfp a (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hx))) hx
    origins := fun b y a hb ho =>
      optP_true (optP_true (hor b (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hb))) hb) ho
    rootChain := fun a y l ha hl hleaf => by
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hz⟩ :=
        optP_true (hrc a (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? ha))) ha l hl hleaf
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hzo, r, -, hr, hlr, hs1, hs2⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hz
      exact ⟨x, z, r, List.mem_cons.1 hx, hz, hzo, hr, hlr, fun l' => ⟨hs1 l', hs2 l'⟩⟩
    rootHeld := fun r hr hu => by
      obtain ⟨i, -, hz⟩ := hrh r (List.mem_range.2 hr.1) hr hu
      obtain ⟨z, hz, za, zo, zm, hpr, hs1, hs2⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hz
      obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hh⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hpr
      exact ⟨i, z, pr, hz, za, zo, zm, hpr, hh, fun l => ⟨hs1 l, hs2 l⟩⟩
    holders := fun a y hy ya => optP_true (hho a (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))) hy ya }
  refine ⟨kInv_of wf ⟨⟨fun a b x y p hab ha hb xa ya xp yp hn hn' => ?_, fun b y a hb ho => ?_,
    fun q hq => h3 q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq, i4_always s⟩, hao,
    fun j y hy ya q hq l hl => ?_⟩ haoh, fun x z l r hx ho hl hr hlr => ?_⟩

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.Common

/-!
# Access kernel: `transfer` (O4, §63)

Properties of `transfer` (§63) and its preservation of the kernel invariant `KInv` (§57) with
`KAux`.

* §63 as written does not preserve `KInv`: `transfer_breaks_kinv` is a reachable state where an
  accepted transfer closes an ownership cycle, breaking holder validity (§49.8) and `NoDangling`
  (§54).
* With the destination usable in the resulting state (an extra hypothesis, not a clause of §63),
  `WF3`, `Inv3`, `NoOrphan` and `KAux` are preserved (`transfer_preserves_wf3_inv3_of_dst_usable`),
  but `AnchorOrderHeld` is not: §63.7 constrains only the moved held authorities, and an authority
  held outside the value whose effective anchor moves with it escapes the check
  (`transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable_fails`, on a state that is not built by kernel steps).
  With the further hypothesis `HeldAnchored` (also not a clause of the spec), `KInv` and `KAux`
  are preserved (`transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable_of_heldAnchored`).
* The effect and rejection theorems of §63.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Helpers on options and stacks -/

/-- Reading `OptP` with default `True` on a present value (§38). -/
private theorem optP_true {α : Type} {o : Option α} {P : α → Prop} {y : α} (h : OptP o P True)
    (hy : o = some y) : P y := by
  subst hy; exact h

/-- `OptP` with default `False` holds on a present value (§38). -/
private theorem optP_false_iff {α : Type} {o : Option α} {P : α → Prop} :
    OptP o P False ↔ ∃ y, o = some y ∧ P y := by
  cases o with
  | none => exact ⟨fun h => h.elim, fun ⟨_, h, _⟩ => by cases h⟩
  | some y => exact ⟨fun h => ⟨y, rfl, h⟩, fun ⟨_, h, hy⟩ => by cases h; exact hy⟩

/-- A frame of the stack is its own ancestor (§39). -/
private theorem ancestor_self {F : Frames} {f : Nat} (h : f ∈ F) : ancestor F f f := by
  unfold ancestor
  induction F with
  | nil => cases h
  | cons g F ih =>
    rw [List.dropWhile_cons]
    by_cases e : g = f
    · subst e; simp
    · have hne : (g != f) = true := by simp [e]
      simp only [hne, ↓reduceIte]
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
      · exact absurd rfl e
      · exact ih h

/-- In a duplicate-free stack `f :: F₀`, a frame of `F₀` does not have `f` as an ancestor (§39,
§49.1). -/
private theorem not_ancestor_top {f g : Nat} {F₀ : Frames} (hnd : (f :: F₀).Nodup) (hg : g ∈ F₀) :
    ¬ ancestor (f :: F₀) f g := by
  have hn := List.nodup_cons.1 hnd
  have hfg : f ≠ g := fun e => hn.1 (e ▸ hg)
  unfold ancestor
  simp only [List.dropWhile_cons, show (f != g) = true by simp [hfg], ↓reduceIte]
  exact fun h => hn.1 (mem_of_mem_dropWhile h)

/-! ## Bounded form of `KInv ∧ KAux` (§49, §50–§54, §57)

Every quantifier of `KInv ∧ KAux` bounded by the indices of `P` and `A`, so that `decide` checks
it on a concrete state. Used only by the counterexamples below. -/

/-- Owner validity of §49.3 for one place (bounded form). -/
private def OwnerOK (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .frame f => f < s.nF
  | .place o => o < s.P.length

/-- Decidability of `OwnerOK` (§49.3). -/
private instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (OwnerOK s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold OwnerOK <;> infer_instance

/-- `KInv ∧ KAux` (§57, §49.7) with every quantifier bounded. -/
private def KInvB (s : S3) : Prop :=
  (s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OptP (s.P[q]?) (fun pl => OptP pl.parent (fun r =>
    OptP (s.P[r]?) (fun pr => r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q) False) True)
    True) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OptP (s.P[q]?) (fun pl => OwnerOK s pl.owner) True) ∧
  (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun x =>
    ∀ l ∈ x.footprint, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l) True) ∧
  (∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => OptP y.origin (fun a => a < b) True)
    True) ∧
  (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => ∀ l ∈ y.footprint, isLeaf s.P l →
    ∃ x ∈ a :: s.ancs a, OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun z => z.origin = none ∧
      ∃ r ∈ List.range s.P.length, RootPlace s.P r ∧ partOf s.P l r ∧
        (∀ l' ∈ z.footprint, l' ∈ footprint s.P r) ∧ ∀ l' ∈ footprint s.P r, l' ∈ z.footprint)
      False) True) ∧
  (∀ r ∈ List.range s.P.length, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r →
    ∃ i ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[i]?) (fun z => z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧
      z.mode = .modify ∧ OptP (s.P[r]?) (fun pr => z.holder = pr.owner) False ∧
      (∀ l ∈ z.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P r) ∧ ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P r, l ∈ z.footprint) False) ∧
  (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
    HolderLive s y.holder) True) ∧
  (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ≠ b →
    OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun x => OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => x.active = true → y.active = true →
      (∃ p ∈ x.footprint, p ∈ y.footprint) → a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a →
      x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe) True) True) ∧
  (∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => OptP y.origin (fun a =>
    OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun x => y.mode.le x.mode ∧ ∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint) False) True)
    True) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x) ∧
  AnchorOrder s ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ¬ s.Usable q → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint) True) ∧
  AnchorOrderHeld s ∧
  (∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun z => z.origin = none →
    ∀ l ∈ z.footprint, ∀ r ∈ List.range s.P.length, RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r →
      OptP (s.P[r]?) (fun pr => z.holder = pr.owner) False) True)

/-- Decidability of `KInvB` (§57). -/
private instance (s : S3) : Decidable (KInvB s) := by unfold KInvB; infer_instance

/-- A place of a footprint is a place of the state (§40). -/
private theorem lt_of_mem_footprint {P : List Place} {q l : Nat} (h : l ∈ footprint P q) :
    q < P.length := by
  obtain ⟨hl, -, -, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 h
  rcases hlq with rfl | hc
  · exact hl
  · exact Nat.lt_trans (chain_lt hc) hl

/-- The bounded form gives `KInv ∧ KAux` (§57, §49.7). -/
private theorem kInvAux_of_bounded {s : S3} (h : KInvB s) : KInv s ∧ KAux s := by
  obtain ⟨hF, hpl, hown, hfp, hor, hrc, hrh, hho, h1, h2, h3, hao, hnd, haoh, hconv⟩ := h
  have wf : WF3 s := {
    frames := hF
    places := fun q pl r hq hp => by
      have := optP_true (optP_true (hpl q (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hq))) hq) hp
      obtain ⟨pr, hpr, h⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 this
      exact ⟨pr, hpr, h⟩
    owners := ⟨fun q pl f hq ho => by
        have := optP_true (hown q (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hq))) hq
        rw [ho] at this; exact this,
      fun q pl o hq ho => by
        have := optP_true (hown q (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hq))) hq
        rw [ho] at this; exact this,
      fun q hq => hq.frameOf⟩
    footprints := fun a x hx => optP_true (hfp a (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hx))) hx
    origins := fun b y a hb ho =>
      optP_true (optP_true (hor b (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hb))) hb) ho
    rootChain := fun a y l ha hl hleaf => by
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hz⟩ :=
        optP_true (hrc a (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? ha))) ha l hl hleaf
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hzo, r, -, hr, hlr, hs1, hs2⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hz
      exact ⟨x, z, r, List.mem_cons.1 hx, hz, hzo, hr, hlr, fun l' => ⟨hs1 l', hs2 l'⟩⟩
    rootHeld := fun r hr hu => by
      obtain ⟨i, -, hz⟩ := hrh r (List.mem_range.2 hr.1) hr hu
      obtain ⟨z, hz, za, zo, zm, hpr, hs1, hs2⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hz
      obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hh⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hpr
      exact ⟨i, z, pr, hz, za, zo, zm, hpr, hh, fun l => ⟨hs1 l, hs2 l⟩⟩
    holders := fun a y hy ya => optP_true (hho a (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))) hy ya }
  refine ⟨kInv_of wf ⟨⟨fun a b x y p hab ha hb xa ya xp yp hn hn' => ?_, fun b y a hb ho => ?_,
    fun q hq => h3 q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq, i4_always s⟩, hao,
    fun j y hy ya q hq l hl => ?_⟩ haoh, fun x z l r hx ho hl hr hlr => ?_⟩
  · exact optP_true (optP_true (h1 a (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? ha)) b
      (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hb)) hab) ha) hb xa ya ⟨p, xp, yp⟩ hn hn'
  · obtain ⟨x, hx, h⟩ := optP_false_iff.1
      (optP_true (optP_true (h2 b (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hb))) hb) ho)
    exact ⟨x, hx, h⟩
  · exact optP_true (hnd j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))) hy ya q
      (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_mem_footprint hl)) hq l hl
  · exact optP_false_iff.1 (optP_true (hconv x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hx))) hx ho l hl
      r (List.mem_range.2 hr.1) hr hlr)

  .step (.step .init (KStep.alloc (pr := 1) (ow := 0) (ls := [(none, 0)])
    (AllocStep.ok (by decide) trivial))) (KStep.alloc (pr := 1) (ow := 2) (ls := [(none, 0)])
    (AllocStep.ok (by decide) trivial))

theorem cyc2_kInv : KInv cyc2 ∧ KAux cyc2 := kInvAux_of_bounded (by decide)

    OptP (cyc3.A[2]?) (fun y => y.holder = .place 3 ∧ 2 ∈ y.footprint) False := by decide

    rw [hy] at this; exact this

cd /Users/guygouri/Devlab/ernlang/ern/formal && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='Ern/MemoryModel/Access/Preserve/Transfer.lean'
s=open(p).read()
marker='/-! ## §63 as written breaks `KInv` (§49.8, §54) -/'
helpers=r'''/-! ## Effect of `transfer` on anchors, frames and usability (§63) -/

/-- Anchors after a transfer (§63, `ok` effect, fourth item): parts of `src` lose theirs, and
place `q` receives those of every part `r` of `src` with `corr(r) = q`. -/
private theorem transfer_D (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) : (transferEff s src dst).D q =
    if partOf s.P q src then [] else s.D q ++ movedTo s src dst q := rfl

/-- Membership in `movedTo` (§63, `ok` effect, fourth item). -/
private theorem mem_movedTo {s : S3} {src dst q x : Nat} :
    x ∈ movedTo s src dst q ↔
      ∃ r, partOf s.P r src ∧ corr s.P src dst r = some q ∧ x ∈ s.D r := by
  simp only [movedTo, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, ⟨-, hr, hc⟩, hx⟩; exact ⟨r, hr, hc, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, hc, hx⟩; exact ⟨r, ⟨hr.1, hr, hc⟩, hx⟩

/-- An anchor of a part of `src` is among the dependencies checked by §63.6. -/
private theorem mem_movedDeps_part {s : S3} {src r x : Nat} (hr : partOf s.P r src)
    (hx : x ∈ s.D r) : x ∈ movedDeps s src := by
  simp only [movedDeps, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, decide_eq_true_eq]
  exact ⟨r, ⟨hr.1, .inl hr⟩, hx⟩

/-- Under `WF3`, a part of `dst` is not a part of `src` when their footprints are disjoint
(§40, §63.3): every place has a leaf. -/
private theorem not_partOf_src {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst r : Nat}
    (hdis : ¬ overlap s.P src dst) (hr : partOf s.P r dst) : ¬ partOf s.P r src := fun hs => by
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := exists_mem_footprint hw (s.P.length - r + 1) r (by omega) hr.1
  exact hdis ⟨l, footprint_sub hw hs hl, footprint_sub hw hr hl⟩

/-- An ownership chain avoiding the storage of `src` is unchanged by the transfer (§40, §63
`ok` effect, third item). -/
private theorem transfer_frameOf_fwd {s : S3} {src dst q f : Nat} (h : FrameOf s q f)
    (hn : ¬ OwnedIn s.P src q) : FrameOf (transferEff s src dst) q f := by
  induction h with
  | @frame q f pl hpl ho =>
    exact .frame (pl := pl) (by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; simp [ho, heldIn]) ho
  | @place q o f pl hpl ho hf ih =>
    have h1 : ¬ partOf s.P o src := fun hp => hn (.direct hpl ho hp)
    have h2 : ¬ OwnedIn s.P src o := fun ho' => hn (.step hpl ho ho')
    exact .place (pl := pl) (by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; simp [ho, heldIn, h1]) ho (ih h2)

/-- A place usable before the transfer whose ownership chain avoids the storage of `src` stays
usable (§40, §63 `ok` effect, third item). -/
private theorem transfer_usable_unmoved {s : S3} {src dst q : Nat} (h : s.Usable q)
    (hn : ¬ OwnedIn s.P src q) : (transferEff s src dst).Usable q := by
  induction h with
  | @frame q f pl hpl hd ho hf =>
    exact .frame (pl := pl) (by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; simp [ho, heldIn]) hd ho hf
  | @place q o pl hpl hd ho _ ih =>
    have h1 : ¬ partOf s.P o src := fun hp => hn (.direct hpl ho hp)
    have h2 : ¬ OwnedIn s.P src o := fun ho' => hn (.step hpl ho ho')
    exact .place (pl := pl) (by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; simp [ho, heldIn, h1]) hd ho (ih h2)

/-- The ownership chain of a place after the transfer (§40, §63 `ok` effect, third item): the
former chain if it avoids the storage of `src`; otherwise it goes through the place
corresponding to a part of `src`. -/
private theorem transfer_frameOf_back {s : S3} {src dst q f : Nat}
    (h : FrameOf (transferEff s src dst) q f) :
    (FrameOf s q f ∧ ¬ OwnedIn s.P src q) ∨
      (OwnedIn s.P src q ∧ ∃ r, partOf s.P r src ∧
        FrameOf (transferEff s src dst) ((corr s.P src dst r).getD dst) f) := by
  induction h with
  | @frame q f pl hpl ho =>
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hpl; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hpl; subst hpl
      split at ho
      · rename_i hh
        obtain ⟨r', e⟩ := mvTo_place (dst := dst) hh
        simp [e] at ho
      · left; refine ⟨.frame h' ho, fun hn => ?_⟩
        cases hn with
        | direct h1 h2 _ => rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2
        | step h1 h2 _ => rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2
  | @place q o f pl hpl ho hf ih =>
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hpl; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hpl; subst hpl
      split at ho
      · rename_i hh
        cases hpo : pl₀.owner with
        | frame g => rw [hpo] at hh; exact hh.elim
        | place r =>
          rw [hpo] at hh ho
          simp only [mvTo, Holder.place.injEq] at ho
          exact .inr ⟨.direct h' hpo hh, r, hh, ho ▸ hf⟩
      · rename_i hh
        rcases ih with ⟨hf0, hn⟩ | ⟨ho', hd⟩
        · left; refine ⟨.place h' ho hf0, fun hq => ?_⟩
          cases hq with
          | direct h1 h2 h3 =>
            rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2; exact hh (by rw [ho]; exact h3)
          | step h1 h2 h3 => rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2; exact hn h3
        · exact .inr ⟨.step h' ho ho', hd⟩

/-- Places with the same owner are owned through the value at `src` together (§40). -/
private theorem ownedIn_of_owner {P : List Place} {src q r : Nat} {pq pr : Place}

    (h : OwnedIn P src q) : OwnedIn P src r := by
  cases h with
  | direct h1 h2 h3 => rw [hq] at h1; cases h1; exact .direct hr (ho.trans h2) h3
  | step h1 h2 h3 => rw [hq] at h1; cases h1; exact .step hr (ho.trans h2) h3

/-- If a place owned through the value at `src` has a frame after the transfer, the destination
is not owned through that value (§40, §63 `ok` effect, third item): otherwise the chain would
come back to it. -/
private theorem transfer_dst_not_owned {s : S3} {src dst f : Nat} (hw : WF3 s) :
    ∀ {q}, FrameOf (transferEff s src dst) q f → OwnedIn s.P src q → ¬ OwnedIn s.P src dst := by
  intro q h
  induction h with
  | @frame q f pl hpl ho =>
    intro hq _
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hpl; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hpl; subst hpl
      split at ho
      · rename_i hh
        obtain ⟨r', e⟩ := mvTo_place (dst := dst) hh
        simp [e] at ho
      · cases hq with
        | direct h1 h2 _ => rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2
        | step h1 h2 _ => rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2
  | @place q o f pl hpl ho hf ih =>
    intro hq hd
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hpl; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hpl; subst hpl
      split at ho
      · rename_i hh
        obtain ⟨r', e, hr'⟩ := mvTo_part hw hd.lt hh
        simp only [e, Holder.place.injEq] at ho; subst ho
        obtain ⟨pl', pd, hpl', hpd, ho'⟩ := hw.ownerOf hr'
        exact ih (ownedIn_of_owner hpd hpl' ho' hd) hd
      · rename_i hh
        cases hq with
        | direct h1 h2 h3 =>
          rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2; exact hh (by rw [ho]; exact h3)
        | step h1 h2 h3 => rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2; exact ih h3 hd

/-- The frame of a place whose ownership chain avoids the storage of `src` is unchanged (§40,
`placeFrame`; §63). -/
private theorem transfer_pframe_unmoved {s : S3} {src dst q : Nat} (hn : ¬ OwnedIn s.P src q) :
    (transferEff s src dst).pframe q = s.pframe q :=
  Option.ext fun f => by
    rw [pframe_iff, pframe_iff]
    exact ⟨fun h => (transfer_frameOf_back h).elim (fun h => h.1) (fun h => absurd h.1 hn),
      fun h => transfer_frameOf_fwd h hn⟩

/-- If the destination has a frame after the transfer, it is still usable (§40, §63): its
ownership chain avoids the storage of `src`. -/
private theorem transfer_usable_dst {s : S3} {src dst g : Nat} (hw : WF3 s)
    (hdst : s.Usable dst) (hg : FrameOf (transferEff s src dst) dst g) :
    (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst := by
  rcases transfer_frameOf_back hg with ⟨-, hn⟩ | ⟨ho, -⟩
  · exact transfer_usable_unmoved hdst hn
  · exact absurd ho (transfer_dst_not_owned hw hg ho)

/-- The effective anchor depends only on the origin chain (§44). -/
private theorem effAnchor_congr {s s' : S3} {x : Nat} (h : s'.ancs x = s.ancs x) :
    s'.effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x := by simp only [S3.effAnchor, h]

/-- `EffAnchorOK` carries over between states whose effective anchors have the same holder frame
and whose ancestor relations agree on the target frame (§44). -/
private theorem effAnchorOK_of_same {s s' : S3} {x x' : Nat} {z z' : Authority}
    (hz : s.A[s.effAnchor x]? = some z) (hz' : s'.A[s'.effAnchor x']? = some z')

    (hanc : ∀ g f, fd = some f → (ancestor s'.F g f ↔ ancestor s.F g f)) (hfd : fd' = fd) :

  rw [hfd]; unfold EffAnchorOK; rw [hz, hz']; simp only [OptP]; rw [hh]
  cases hg : s.hframe z.holder with
  | none => simp
  | some g =>
    cases hf : fd with
    | none => simp
    | some f => simp only; rw [hanc g f hf]

the holder of the effective anchor and its frame are unchanged. -/

    (hz : s.A[s.effAnchor x]? = some z) (hm : ¬ AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor x))
    (fd : Option Nat) :
    EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x fd ↔ EffAnchorOK s x fd := by
  have hm' : ¬ HolderMoves s src z.holder := by unfold AnchorMoves at hm; rw [hz] at hm; exact hm
  have hnh : ¬ heldIn s.P src z.holder := by
    cases hh : z.holder with
    | frame g => simp [heldIn]
    | place p => rw [hh] at hm'; exact fun h => hm' (.inl h)
  have he : (transferEff s src dst).effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x :=
    effAnchor_congr (by rw [(transfer_skel s src dst).ancs])
  refine effAnchorOK_of_same (z' := z) hz (by rw [he, transfer_A_get, hz]; simp [hnh]) ?_
    (fun _ _ _ => Iff.rfl) rfl
  cases hh : z.holder with
  | frame g => rfl
  | place p =>
    rw [hh] at hm'
    exact transfer_pframe_unmoved (fun ho => hm' (.inr ho))

/-! ## Preservation under extra hypotheses (§57, §63) -/

/-- §49.7 (`RootHeld`) after a transfer of a usable `src`: the holder of a root authority and the
owner of its root place change together (§40, §63 `ok` effect, third item). -/
private theorem transfer_rootHeld {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hw : WF3 s) (hsrc : s.Usable src) :
    RootHeld (transferEff s src dst) := by
  intro r hrp hur
  have hrp0 : RootPlace s.P r := by
    simpa only [RootPlace, transfer_len, transfer_parentOf] using hrp
  obtain ⟨i, z, pr, hz, za, zo, zm, hpr, hzh, hzf⟩ :=
    hw.rootHeld r hrp0 (transfer_usable_back hw hsrc hur)
  have hf : ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint (transferEff s src dst).P r := fun l => by
    rw [transfer_footprint]; exact hzf l
  by_cases hc : heldIn s.P src z.holder
  · have hc' : heldIn s.P src pr.owner := hzh ▸ hc
    exact ⟨i, { z with holder := mvTo s.P src dst z.holder },
      { pr with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pr.owner },
      by rw [transfer_A_get, hz]; simp [hc], za, zo, zm, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpr]; simp [hc'],
      by simp [hzh], hf⟩
  · have hc' : ¬ heldIn s.P src pr.owner := hzh ▸ hc
    exact ⟨i, z, pr, by rw [transfer_A_get, hz]; simp [hc], za, zo, zm,
      by rw [transfer_P_get, hpr]; simp [hc'], hzh, hf⟩

/-- `KAux` (`RootHeldConv`, §40, §49.7) after a transfer: the holder of a root authority and the
owner of its root place change together (§63 `ok` effect, third item). -/
private theorem transfer_rootHeldConv {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hr : RootHeldConv s) :
    RootHeldConv (transferEff s src dst) := by
  intro x z' l r hx ho hl hrp hlr
  rw [transfer_A_get] at hx
  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hx
  have ho' : z.origin = none := by split at ho <;> exact ho
  have hl' : l ∈ z.footprint := by split at hl <;> exact hl
  have hrp' : RootPlace s.P r := by
    simpa only [RootPlace, transfer_len, transfer_parentOf] using hrp
  have hlr' : partOf s.P l r := (transfer_partOf s src dst l r).1 hlr
  obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hh⟩ := hr x z l r hz ho' hl' hrp' hlr'
  refine ⟨_, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpr]; rfl, ?_⟩
  by_cases hc : heldIn s.P src pr.owner <;> simp [hc, hh]

/-- `WF3` (§49) after an accepted transfer whose destination is usable in the resulting state.
Only §49.8 (holder validity) uses the destination's usability. -/
private theorem transfer_wf3 {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (hpre : TransferPre k s src dst) (hd' : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst) :
    WF3 (transferEff s src dst) := by
  have sk := transfer_skel s src dst
  have hdl := hpre.dstUsable.lt
  refine ⟨hwf.frames, ?_, ⟨?_, ?_, fun q hq => hq.frameOf⟩, fun a x hx l hl => ?_,
    sk.origins hwf.origins,
    sk.rootChain hwf.rootChain (transfer_len s src dst) (transfer_parentOf s src dst),
    transfer_rootHeld hwf hpre.srcUsable, ?_⟩
  · intro q pl r hq hp
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hq
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hq; cases hq
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hq; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hq; subst hq
      have hp₀ : pl₀.parent = some r := by split at hp <;> exact hp
      obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hlt, ho, hdd⟩ := hwf.places q pl₀ r h' hp₀
      refine ⟨_, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpr]; rfl, hlt, ?_, hdd⟩
      by_cases hc : heldIn s.P src pl₀.owner <;> simp [hc, ho]
  · intro q pl f hq ho
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hq
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hq; cases hq
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hq; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hq; subst hq
      split at ho
      · rename_i hh
        obtain ⟨r', e⟩ := mvTo_place (dst := dst) hh
        simp [e] at ho
      · exact hwf.owners.1 q pl₀ f h' ho
  · intro q pl o hq ho
    rw [transfer_len]; rw [transfer_P_get] at hq
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hq; cases hq
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hq; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hq; subst hq
      split at ho
      · rename_i hh
        obtain ⟨r', e, hr'⟩ := mvTo_part hwf hdl hh
        simp only [e, Holder.place.injEq] at ho; subst ho; exact hr'.1
      · exact hwf.owners.2.1 q pl₀ o h' ho
  · have := sk.footprints hwf.footprints a x hx l hl
    simpa only [isLeaf, transfer_len, transfer_parentOf] using this
  · intro a y hy ya
    rw [transfer_A_get] at hy
    cases h' : s.A[a]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hy; cases hy
    | some y₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hy; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hy; subst hy
      have ya₀ : y₀.active = true := by split at ya <;> exact ya
      have hl := hwf.holders a y₀ h' ya₀
      split
      · rename_i hh
        obtain ⟨r', e, hr'⟩ := mvTo_part hwf hdl hh
        show HolderLive _ (mvTo s.P src dst y₀.holder)
        rw [e]; exact transfer_usable_part hwf hr' hd'
      · cases hh : y₀.holder with
        | frame f => rw [hh] at hl; exact hl
        | place p => rw [hh] at hl; exact transfer_usable_fwd hwf hd' hl

/-- `Inv3` (§57) after an accepted transfer whose destination is usable in the resulting state.
`I1`, `I2` (§50, §51): no authority changes but its holder; `I3` (§52): kept anchors come from
usable places, moved ones are checked by §63.6; `AnchorOrder` is §63.6; `NoDangling` (§54): no
usable place becomes unusable. -/
private theorem transfer_inv3 {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3 s)
    (hpre : TransferPre k s src dst) (hd' : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst) :
    Inv3 (transferEff s src dst) := by
  have sk := transfer_skel s src dst
  obtain ⟨⟨i1, i2, i3, -⟩, -, hnd⟩ := hinv
  refine ⟨⟨sk.i1 i1, sk.i2 i2, fun q hq x hx => ?_, i4_always _⟩, hpre.anchorOrder, ?_⟩
  · have hq' := transfer_usable_back hwf hpre.srcUsable hq
    refine sk.active.2 ?_
    rw [transfer_D] at hx
    split at hx
    · simp at hx
    · rcases List.mem_append.1 hx with hx | hx
      · exact i3 q hq' x hx
      · obtain ⟨r, hr, -, hxr⟩ := mem_movedTo.1 hx
        exact hpre.depsValid x (mem_movedDeps_part hr hxr)
  · intro j y hy ya q hq l hl hly
    rw [transfer_A_get] at hy
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
    have ya₀ : y₀.active = true := by split at ya <;> exact ya
    have hly₀ : l ∈ y₀.footprint := by split at hly <;> exact hly
    rw [transfer_footprint] at hl
    exact hnd j y₀ hy₀ ya₀ q (fun hu => hq (transfer_usable_fwd hwf hd' hu)) l hl hly₀

/-- With the destination usable in the resulting state, an accepted transfer preserves `WF3`,
`Inv3`, `NoOrphan` (§57) and `KAux` (§40, §49.7). The hypothesis `hd'` is not a clause of §63:
`transfer_breaks_kinv` shows that §63 does not imply it. -/
theorem transfer_preserves_wf3_inv3_of_dst_usable {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s) (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s'))
    (hd' : s'.Usable dst) : WF3 s' ∧ Inv3 s' ∧ NoOrphan s' ∧ KAux s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hw' := transfer_wf3 hinv.1 hpre hd'
  exact ⟨hw', transfer_inv3 hinv.1 hinv.2.1 hpre hd', noOrphan_of_wf3 hw',
    transfer_rootHeldConv haux⟩

/-- Auxiliary hypothesis, not a clause of §63 nor of the invariant of §57: every active derived
authority held by a usable place is among the anchors of that place (§44). `store` (§65) adds
the stored authority to the anchors of its target, and the `ok` effect of §63 moves an
authority held by a part `r` of the source together with the anchors of `r`. -/
def HeldAnchored (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
    y.holder = .place q → s.Usable q → x ∈ s.D q

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44, §54) after an accepted transfer, under `HeldAnchored`: a moved held
authority is checked by §63.7; an unmoved derived one is an anchor of its unmoved holder,
checked by `AnchorOrder` in the resulting state (§63.6); an unmoved root authority is its own
effective anchor, held by the place. -/
private theorem transfer_anchorOrderHeld {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (hpre : TransferPre k s src dst) :
    AnchorOrderHeld (transferEff s src dst) := by
  intro q hq x y hy ya hh
  have hy' := hy
  rw [transfer_A_get] at hy
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
  by_cases hm : AnchorMoves s src x
  · have e := hpre.anchorOrderHeld x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy₀)) hm q
      (List.mem_range.2 (by rw [← transfer_len s src dst]; exact hq.lt)) hq
    rw [hy'] at e
    exact e ya hh
  · have hmv : ¬ HolderMoves s src y₀.holder := by
      unfold AnchorMoves at hm; rw [hy₀] at hm; exact hm
    have hnh : ¬ heldIn s.P src y₀.holder := by
      cases e : y₀.holder with
      | frame g => simp [heldIn]
      | place p => rw [e] at hmv; exact fun h => hmv (.inl h)
    simp only [hnh, ↓reduceIte] at ya hh hy'
    have hqs : ¬ partOf s.P q src := by rw [hh] at hmv; exact fun h => hmv (.inl h)
    cases ho : y₀.origin with
    | none =>
      have hex : (transferEff s src dst).effAnchor x = x := by
        have : (transferEff s src dst).org x = none := by simp [S3.org, hy', ho]
        simp [S3.effAnchor, S3.ancs, chain_none this]
      obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hq.frameOf
      unfold EffAnchorOK
      rw [hex, hy', pframe_iff.2 hf]
      simp only [OptP, hh, S3.hframe, pframe_iff.2 hf]
      exact ancestor_self hfF
    | some o =>
      have hxq := hheld x y₀ q hy₀ ya (by rw [ho]; exact fun h => by cases h) hh
        (transfer_usable_back hwf hpre.srcUsable hq)
      have hxq' : x ∈ (transferEff s src dst).D q := by
        rw [transfer_D]; simp only [hqs, ↓reduceIte]; exact List.mem_append_left _ hxq
      exact hpre.anchorOrder q hq x hxq'

/-- With the destination usable in the resulting state and `HeldAnchored`, an accepted transfer
preserves `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` (§40, §49.7). Neither hypothesis is a clause of §63:
`transfer_breaks_kinv` shows that §63 does not imply the first, and
`transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable_fails` that `KInv ∧ KAux` and the first do not suffice. -/
theorem transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable_of_heldAnchored {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s) (hheld : HeldAnchored s)
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) (hd' : s'.Usable dst) : KInv s' ∧ KAux s' := by
  obtain ⟨hw', hi', -, ha'⟩ := transfer_preserves_wf3_inv3_of_dst_usable hinv haux h hd'
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact ⟨kInv_of hw' hi' (transfer_anchorOrderHeld hinv.1 hheld hpre), ha'⟩

    (h : OwnedIn P src q) : OwnedIn P src r := by

  | step h1 h2 h3 => rw [hq] at h1; cases h1; exact .step hr (ho.trans h2) h3

is not owned through that value (§40, §63 `ok` effect, third item): otherwise the chain would

private theorem transfer_dst_not_owned {s : S3} {src dst f : Nat} (hw : WF3 s) :

  intro q h

    cases h' : s.P[q]? with

        | direct h1 h2 h3 =>
          rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2; exact hh (by rw [ho]; exact h3)
        | step h1 h2 h3 => rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2; exact ih h3 hd

/-- The frame of a place whose ownership chain avoids the storage of `src` is unchanged (§40,
`placeFrame`; §63). -/
private theorem transfer_pframe_unmoved {s : S3} {src dst q : Nat} (hn : ¬ OwnedIn s.P src q) :
    (transferEff s src dst).pframe q = s.pframe q :=
  Option.ext fun f => by
    rw [pframe_iff, pframe_iff]
    exact ⟨fun h => (transfer_frameOf_back h).elim (fun h => h.1) (fun h => absurd h.1 hn),
      fun h => transfer_frameOf_fwd h hn⟩

/-- If the destination has a frame after the transfer, it is still usable (§40, §63): its
ownership chain avoids the storage of `src`. -/
private theorem transfer_usable_dst {s : S3} {src dst g : Nat} (hw : WF3 s)
    (hdst : s.Usable dst) (hg : FrameOf (transferEff s src dst) dst g) :
    (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst := by
  rcases transfer_frameOf_back hg with ⟨-, hn⟩ | ⟨ho, -⟩
  · exact transfer_usable_unmoved hdst hn
  · exact absurd ho (transfer_dst_not_owned hw hg ho)

/-- The effective anchor depends only on the origin chain (§44). -/
private theorem effAnchor_congr {s s' : S3} {x : Nat} (h : s'.ancs x = s.ancs x) :
    s'.effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x := by simp only [S3.effAnchor, h]

/-- `EffAnchorOK` carries over between states whose effective anchors have the same holder frame
and whose ancestor relations agree on the target frame (§44). -/
private theorem effAnchorOK_of_same {s s' : S3} {x x' : Nat} {z z' : Authority}
    (hz : s.A[s.effAnchor x]? = some z) (hz' : s'.A[s'.effAnchor x']? = some z')
    (hh : s'.hframe z'.holder = s.hframe z.holder) {fd fd' : Option Nat}
    (hanc : ∀ g f, fd = some f → (ancestor s'.F g f ↔ ancestor s.F g f)) (hfd : fd' = fd) :
    EffAnchorOK s' x' fd' ↔ EffAnchorOK s x fd := by
  rw [hfd]; unfold EffAnchorOK; rw [hz, hz']; simp only [OptP]; rw [hh]
  cases hg : s.hframe z.holder with
  | none => simp
  | some g =>
    cases hf : fd with
    | none => simp
    | some f => simp only; rw [hanc g f hf]

/-- An anchor whose effective anchor does not move with the value keeps its order (§44, §63):
the holder of the effective anchor and its frame are unchanged. -/
private theorem transfer_effAnchorOK_unmoved {s : S3} {src dst x : Nat} {z : Authority}
    (hz : s.A[s.effAnchor x]? = some z) (hm : ¬ AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor x))
    (fd : Option Nat) :
    EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x fd ↔ EffAnchorOK s x fd := by
  have hm' : ¬ HolderMoves s src z.holder := by unfold AnchorMoves at hm; rw [hz] at hm; exact hm
  have hnh : ¬ heldIn s.P src z.holder := by
    cases hh : z.holder with
    | frame g => simp [heldIn]
    | place p => rw [hh] at hm'; exact fun h => hm' (.inl h)
  have he : (transferEff s src dst).effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x :=
    effAnchor_congr (by rw [(transfer_skel s src dst).ancs])
  refine effAnchorOK_of_same (z' := z) hz (by rw [he, transfer_A_get, hz]; simp [hnh]) ?_
    (fun _ _ _ => Iff.rfl) rfl
  cases hh : z.holder with
  | frame g => rfl
  | place p =>
    rw [hh] at hm'
    exact transfer_pframe_unmoved (fun ho => hm' (.inr ho))

/-! ## Preservation under extra hypotheses (§57, §63) -/

/-- §49.7 (`RootHeld`) after a transfer of a usable `src`: the holder of a root authority and the
owner of its root place change together (§40, §63 `ok` effect, third item). -/
private theorem transfer_rootHeld {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hw : WF3 s) (hsrc : s.Usable src) :
    RootHeld (transferEff s src dst) := by
  intro r hrp hur
  have hrp0 : RootPlace s.P r := by
    simpa only [RootPlace, transfer_len, transfer_parentOf] using hrp
  obtain ⟨i, z, pr, hz, za, zo, zm, hpr, hzh, hzf⟩ :=
    hw.rootHeld r hrp0 (transfer_usable_back hw hsrc hur)
  have hf : ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint (transferEff s src dst).P r := fun l => by
    rw [transfer_footprint]; exact hzf l
  by_cases hc : heldIn s.P src z.holder
  · have hc' : heldIn s.P src pr.owner := hzh ▸ hc
    exact ⟨i, { z with holder := mvTo s.P src dst z.holder },
      { pr with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pr.owner },
      by rw [transfer_A_get, hz]; simp [hc], za, zo, zm, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpr]; simp [hc'],
      by simp [hzh], hf⟩
  · have hc' : ¬ heldIn s.P src pr.owner := hzh ▸ hc
    exact ⟨i, z, pr, by rw [transfer_A_get, hz]; simp [hc], za, zo, zm,
      by rw [transfer_P_get, hpr]; simp [hc'], hzh, hf⟩

/-- `KAux` (`RootHeldConv`, §40, §49.7) after a transfer: the holder of a root authority and the
owner of its root place change together (§63 `ok` effect, third item). -/
private theorem transfer_rootHeldConv {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hr : RootHeldConv s) :
    RootHeldConv (transferEff s src dst) := by
  intro x z' l r hx ho hl hrp hlr
  rw [transfer_A_get] at hx
  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hx
  have ho' : z.origin = none := by split at ho <;> exact ho
  have hl' : l ∈ z.footprint := by split at hl <;> exact hl
  have hrp' : RootPlace s.P r := by
    simpa only [RootPlace, transfer_len, transfer_parentOf] using hrp
  have hlr' : partOf s.P l r := (transfer_partOf s src dst l r).1 hlr
  obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hh⟩ := hr x z l r hz ho' hl' hrp' hlr'
  refine ⟨_, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpr]; rfl, ?_⟩
  by_cases hc : heldIn s.P src pr.owner <;> simp [hc, hh]

/-- `WF3` (§49) after an accepted transfer whose destination is usable in the resulting state.
Only §49.8 (holder validity) uses the destination's usability. -/
private theorem transfer_wf3 {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (hpre : TransferPre k s src dst) (hd' : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst) :
    WF3 (transferEff s src dst) := by
  have sk := transfer_skel s src dst
  have hdl := hpre.dstUsable.lt
  refine ⟨hwf.frames, ?_, ⟨?_, ?_, fun q hq => hq.frameOf⟩, fun a x hx l hl => ?_,
    sk.origins hwf.origins,
    sk.rootChain hwf.rootChain (transfer_len s src dst) (transfer_parentOf s src dst),
    transfer_rootHeld hwf hpre.srcUsable, ?_⟩
  · intro q pl r hq hp
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hq
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hq; cases hq
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hq; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hq; subst hq
      have hp₀ : pl₀.parent = some r := by split at hp <;> exact hp
      obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hlt, ho, hdd⟩ := hwf.places q pl₀ r h' hp₀
      refine ⟨_, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpr]; rfl, hlt, ?_, hdd⟩
      by_cases hc : heldIn s.P src pl₀.owner <;> simp [hc, ho]
  · intro q pl f hq ho
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hq
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hq; cases hq
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hq; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hq; subst hq
      split at ho
      · rename_i hh
        obtain ⟨r', e⟩ := mvTo_place (dst := dst) hh
        simp [e] at ho
      · exact hwf.owners.1 q pl₀ f h' ho
  · intro q pl o hq ho
    rw [transfer_len]; rw [transfer_P_get] at hq
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hq; cases hq
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hq; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hq; subst hq
      split at ho
      · rename_i hh
        obtain ⟨r', e, hr'⟩ := mvTo_part hwf hdl hh
        simp only [e, Holder.place.injEq] at ho; subst ho; exact hr'.1
      · exact hwf.owners.2.1 q pl₀ o h' ho
  · have := sk.footprints hwf.footprints a x hx l hl
    simpa only [isLeaf, transfer_len, transfer_parentOf] using this
  · intro a y hy ya
    rw [transfer_A_get] at hy
    cases h' : s.A[a]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hy; cases hy
    | some y₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hy; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hy; subst hy
      have ya₀ : y₀.active = true := by split at ya <;> exact ya
      have hl := hwf.holders a y₀ h' ya₀
      split
      · rename_i hh
        obtain ⟨r', e, hr'⟩ := mvTo_part hwf hdl hh
        show HolderLive _ (mvTo s.P src dst y₀.holder)
        rw [e]; exact transfer_usable_part hwf hr' hd'
      · cases hh : y₀.holder with
        | frame f => rw [hh] at hl; exact hl
        | place p => rw [hh] at hl; exact transfer_usable_fwd hwf hd' hl

/-- `Inv3` (§57) after an accepted transfer whose destination is usable in the resulting state.
`I1`, `I2` (§50, §51): no authority changes but its holder; `I3` (§52): kept anchors come from
usable places, moved ones are checked by §63.6; `AnchorOrder` is §63.6; `NoDangling` (§54): no
usable place becomes unusable. -/
private theorem transfer_inv3 {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3 s)
    (hpre : TransferPre k s src dst) (hd' : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst) :
    Inv3 (transferEff s src dst) := by
  have sk := transfer_skel s src dst
  obtain ⟨⟨i1, i2, i3, -⟩, -, hnd⟩ := hinv
  refine ⟨⟨sk.i1 i1, sk.i2 i2, fun q hq x hx => ?_, i4_always _⟩, hpre.anchorOrder, ?_⟩
  · have hq' := transfer_usable_back hwf hpre.srcUsable hq
    refine sk.active.2 ?_
    rw [transfer_D] at hx
    split at hx
    · simp at hx
    · rcases List.mem_append.1 hx with hx | hx
      · exact i3 q hq' x hx
      · obtain ⟨r, hr, -, hxr⟩ := mem_movedTo.1 hx
        exact hpre.depsValid x (mem_movedDeps_part hr hxr)
  · intro j y hy ya q hq l hl hly
    rw [transfer_A_get] at hy
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
    have ya₀ : y₀.active = true := by split at ya <;> exact ya
    have hly₀ : l ∈ y₀.footprint := by split at hly <;> exact hly
    rw [transfer_footprint] at hl
    exact hnd j y₀ hy₀ ya₀ q (fun hu => hq (transfer_usable_fwd hwf hd' hu)) l hl hly₀

/-- With the destination usable in the resulting state, an accepted transfer preserves `WF3`,
`Inv3`, `NoOrphan` (§57) and `KAux` (§40, §49.7). The hypothesis `hd'` is not a clause of §63:
`transfer_breaks_kinv` shows that §63 does not imply it. -/
theorem transfer_preserves_wf3_inv3_of_dst_usable {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s) (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s'))
    (hd' : s'.Usable dst) : WF3 s' ∧ Inv3 s' ∧ NoOrphan s' ∧ KAux s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hw' := transfer_wf3 hinv.1 hpre hd'
  exact ⟨hw', transfer_inv3 hinv.1 hinv.2.1 hpre hd', noOrphan_of_wf3 hw',
    transfer_rootHeldConv haux⟩

/-- Auxiliary hypothesis, not a clause of §63 nor of the invariant of §57: every active derived
authority held by a usable place is among the anchors of that place (§44). `store` (§65) adds
the stored authority to the anchors of its target, and the `ok` effect of §63 moves an
authority held by a part `r` of the source together with the anchors of `r`. -/
def HeldAnchored (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
    y.holder = .place q → s.Usable q → x ∈ s.D q

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44, §54) after an accepted transfer, under `HeldAnchored`: a moved held
authority is checked by §63.7; an unmoved derived one is an anchor of its unmoved holder,
checked by `AnchorOrder` in the resulting state (§63.6); an unmoved root authority is its own
effective anchor, held by the place. -/
private theorem transfer_anchorOrderHeld {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (hpre : TransferPre k s src dst) :
    AnchorOrderHeld (transferEff s src dst) := by
  intro q hq x y hy ya hh
  have hy' := hy
  rw [transfer_A_get] at hy
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
  by_cases hm : AnchorMoves s src x
  · have e := hpre.anchorOrderHeld x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy₀)) hm q
      (List.mem_range.2 (by rw [← transfer_len s src dst]; exact hq.lt)) hq
    rw [hy'] at e
    exact e ya hh
  · have hmv : ¬ HolderMoves s src y₀.holder := by
      unfold AnchorMoves at hm; rw [hy₀] at hm; exact hm
    have hnh : ¬ heldIn s.P src y₀.holder := by
      cases e : y₀.holder with
      | frame g => simp [heldIn]
      | place p => rw [e] at hmv; exact fun h => hmv (.inl h)
    simp only [hnh, ↓reduceIte] at ya hh hy'
    have hqs : ¬ partOf s.P q src := by rw [hh] at hmv; exact fun h => hmv (.inl h)
    cases ho : y₀.origin with
    | none =>
      have hex : (transferEff s src dst).effAnchor x = x := by
        have : (transferEff s src dst).org x = none := by simp [S3.org, hy', ho]
        simp [S3.effAnchor, S3.ancs, chain_none this]
      obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hq.frameOf
      unfold EffAnchorOK
      rw [hex, hy', pframe_iff.2 hf]
      simp only [OptP, hh, S3.hframe, pframe_iff.2 hf]
      exact ancestor_self hfF
    | some o =>
      have hxq := hheld x y₀ q hy₀ ya (by rw [ho]; exact fun h => by cases h) hh
        (transfer_usable_back hwf hpre.srcUsable hq)
      have hxq' : x ∈ (transferEff s src dst).D q := by
        rw [transfer_D]; simp only [hqs, ↓reduceIte]; exact List.mem_append_left _ hxq
      exact hpre.anchorOrder q hq x hxq'

/-- With the destination usable in the resulting state and `HeldAnchored`, an accepted transfer
preserves `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` (§40, §49.7). Neither hypothesis is a clause of §63:
`transfer_breaks_kinv` shows that §63 does not imply the first, and
`transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable_fails` that `KInv ∧ KAux` and the first do not suffice. -/
theorem transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable_of_heldAnchored {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s) (hheld : HeldAnchored s)
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) (hd' : s'.Usable dst) : KInv s' ∧ KAux s' := by
  obtain ⟨hw', hi', -, ha'⟩ := transfer_preserves_wf3_inv3_of_dst_usable hinv haux h hd'
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact ⟨kInv_of hw' hi' (transfer_anchorOrderHeld hinv.1 hheld hpre), ha'⟩

  · exact h1.elim

    rw [transfer_A_get, ha]; simp [hh, e]

    cases e' : y.holder with

    | place p => rw [e'] at hh; exact .inl hh

authorities held within the source, the ones the transfer moves. Two states with the same places

    (hA : ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), (s.A[j]? = some y ∨ s'.A[j]? = some y) →
      heldIn s.P src y.holder → s'.A[j]? = s.A[j]?) :

  have key : ∀ (t t' : S3), t'.P = t.P →

    obtain ⟨y, hy, hh⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hheld
    rw [hP] at hh

    refine h j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy')) (optP_false_iff.2 ⟨y, hy', hh⟩) ?_
    have ga : (transferEff t' src dst).A[j]? = (transferEff t src dst).A[j]? := by
      rw [transfer_A_get, transfer_A_get, e, hP]
    have gl : holderLeaves (transferEff t' src dst) = holderLeaves (transferEff t src dst) := by

      | frame f => rfl

    rw [ga, gl] at hsl

  rw [hP] at hh
  exact (hA j y hy.symm hh).symm

    (∀ q x, x ∈ s'.D q → (¬ partOf s.P q src ∧ x ∈ s.D q) ∨
      ∃ r, partOf s.P r src ∧ corr s.P src dst r = some q ∧ x ∈ s.D r) := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  refine ⟨fun r hr => ?_, fun r hr => by rw [transfer_D]; simp [hr],
    fun q hq x hx => by rw [transfer_D]; simp only [hq, ↓reduceIte]; exact List.mem_append_left _ hx,
    fun q x hx => ?_⟩
  · have h1 := hpre.sameShape.1 r (List.mem_range.2 hr.1) hr
    obtain ⟨r', hc, -⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 h1
    have hr' := corr_partOf hwf hpre.dstUsable.lt (r + 1) r r' (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hc
    refine ⟨r', hc, hr', fun x hx => ?_⟩
    rw [transfer_D]; simp only [not_partOf_src hwf hpre.disjoint hr', ↓reduceIte]
    exact List.mem_append_right _ (mem_movedTo.2 ⟨r, hr, hc, hx⟩)
  · rw [transfer_D] at hx
    split at hx
    · simp at hx
    · rename_i hq
      rcases List.mem_append.1 hx with hx | hx
      · exact .inl ⟨hq, hx⟩
      · exact .inr (mem_movedTo.1 hx)

/-- §63.6 rejects an escape through anchors: if a part of the source is anchored on an authority
`a` whose effective anchor does not move with the value and belongs to the current frame `f`,
the transfer to a destination whose frame, in the resulting state, is an older frame `g` is
rejected. The anchor follows the value to the corresponding part of the destination (§63 `ok`
effect, fourth item), where `AnchorOrder` (§44) fails in the resulting state. -/
theorem anchor_escape_rejected_at_transfer {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst a f g : Nat}
    {F₀ : Frames} {z : Authority} (hwf : WF3 s) (hF : s.F = f :: F₀) (ha : a ∈ depsOf s src)
    (hz : s.A[s.effAnchor a]? = some z) (hm : ¬ AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor a))
    (hzf : s.hframe z.holder = some f)
    (hg : (transferEff s src dst).pframe dst = some g) (hgF : g ∈ F₀) :
    TransferStep k src dst s .reject := by
  refine .reject fun hpre => ?_
  have hdst := transfer_usable_dst hwf hpre.dstUsable (pframe_iff.1 hg)
  simp only [depsOf, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, decide_eq_true_eq] at ha
  obtain ⟨r, ⟨-, hr⟩, hx⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨r', hc, -⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 (hpre.sameShape.1 r (List.mem_range.2 hr.1) hr)
  have hr' := corr_partOf hwf hpre.dstUsable.lt (r + 1) r r' (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hc
  have hin : a ∈ (transferEff s src dst).D r' := by
    rw [transfer_D]; simp only [not_partOf_src hwf hpre.disjoint hr', ↓reduceIte]
    exact List.mem_append_right _ (mem_movedTo.2 ⟨r, hr, hc, hx⟩)
  have hok := hpre.anchorOrder r' (transfer_usable_part hwf hr' hdst) a hin
  rw [transfer_pframe_part hwf hr', transfer_effAnchorOK_unmoved hz hm, hg] at hok
  unfold EffAnchorOK at hok
  rw [hz] at hok
  simp only [OptP, hzf] at hok
  rw [hF] at hok
  exact not_ancestor_top (hF ▸ hwf.frames.2.1) hgF hok

/-- §63.7 rejects an escape through held authorities: if a part of the source holds an active
authority `a` whose effective anchor does not move with the value and belongs to the current
frame `f`, the transfer to a destination whose frame, in the resulting state, is an older frame
`g` is rejected. The authority moves to the corresponding part of the destination (§63 `ok`
effect, second item), where `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) fails in the resulting state. -/
theorem store_escape_rejected_at_transfer {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst a f g : Nat} {F₀ : Frames}
    {y z : Authority} (hwf : WF3 s) (hF : s.F = f :: F₀) (ha : s.A[a]? = some y)
    (ya : y.active = true) (hh : heldIn s.P src y.holder)
    (hz : s.A[s.effAnchor a]? = some z) (hm : ¬ AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor a))
    (hzf : s.hframe z.holder = some f)
    (hg : (transferEff s src dst).pframe dst = some g) (hgF : g ∈ F₀) :
    TransferStep k src dst s .reject := by
  refine .reject fun hpre => ?_
  have hdst := transfer_usable_dst hwf hpre.dstUsable (pframe_iff.1 hg)
  obtain ⟨r', e, hr'⟩ := mvTo_part hwf hpre.dstUsable.lt hh
  have ha' : (transferEff s src dst).A[a]? = some { y with holder := .place r' } := by
    rw [transfer_A_get, ha]; simp [hh, e]
  have hmv : AnchorMoves s src a := by
    unfold AnchorMoves; rw [ha]
    cases e' : y.holder with
    | frame _ => rw [e'] at hh; exact hh.elim
    | place p => rw [e'] at hh; exact .inl hh
  have hok := hpre.anchorOrderHeld a (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? ha)) hmv r'
    (List.mem_range.2 hr'.1) (transfer_usable_part hwf hr' hdst)
  rw [ha'] at hok
  have hok := hok ya rfl
  rw [transfer_pframe_part hwf hr', transfer_effAnchorOK_unmoved hz hm, hg] at hok
  unfold EffAnchorOK at hok
  rw [hz] at hok
  simp only [OptP, hzf] at hok
  rw [hF] at hok
  exact not_ancestor_top (hF ▸ hwf.frames.2.1) hgF hok

/-- §63.8 is a local check: its decision depends on the state only through the places and the
authorities held within the source, the ones the transfer moves. Two states with the same places
and the same such authorities, at the same identities, get the same decision; no global
authority-acyclicity check is involved. -/
theorem noLocalSelfLock_local {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hP : s'.P = s.P)
    (hA : ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), (s.A[j]? = some y ∨ s'.A[j]? = some y) →
      heldIn s.P src y.holder → s'.A[j]? = s.A[j]?) :
    NoLocalSelfLock s' src dst ↔ NoLocalSelfLock s src dst := by
  have key : ∀ (t t' : S3), t'.P = t.P →
      (∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), (t.A[j]? = some y ∨ t'.A[j]? = some y) →
        heldIn t.P src y.holder → t'.A[j]? = t.A[j]?) →
      NoLocalSelfLock t src dst → NoLocalSelfLock t' src dst := by
    intro t t' hP hA h j _ hheld hsl
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hh⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hheld
    rw [hP] at hh
    have e := hA j y (.inr hy) hh
    have hy' : t.A[j]? = some y := e.symm.trans hy
    refine h j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy')) (optP_false_iff.2 ⟨y, hy', hh⟩) ?_
    have ga : (transferEff t' src dst).A[j]? = (transferEff t src dst).A[j]? := by
      rw [transfer_A_get, transfer_A_get, e, hP]
    have gl : holderLeaves (transferEff t' src dst) = holderLeaves (transferEff t src dst) := by
      funext hd
      cases hd with
      | place p => simp only [holderLeaves, transferEff, hP]
      | frame f => rfl
    unfold SelfLock at hsl ⊢
    rw [ga, gl] at hsl
    exact hsl
  refine ⟨key s' s hP.symm (fun j y hy hh => ?_), key s s' hP hA⟩
  rw [hP] at hh
  exact (hA j y hy.symm hh).symm

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

1	import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.Common
2	
3	/-!
4	# Access kernel: `transfer` (O4, §63)
5	
6	Properties of `transfer` (§63) and its preservation of the kernel invariant `KInv` (§57) with
7	`KAux`.
8	
9	* §63 as written does not preserve `KInv`: `transfer_breaks_kinv` is a reachable state where an
10	  accepted transfer closes an ownership cycle, breaking holder validity (§49.8) and `NoDangling`
11	  (§54).
12	* With the destination usable in the resulting state (an extra hypothesis, not a clause of §63),
13	  `WF3`, `Inv3`, `NoOrphan` and `KAux` are preserved (`transfer_preserves_wf3_inv3_of_dst_usable`),
14	  but `AnchorOrderHeld` is not: §63.7 constrains only the moved held authorities, and an authority
15	  held outside the value whose effective anchor moves with it escapes the check
16	  (`transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable_fails`, on a state that is not built by kernel steps).
17	  With the further hypothesis `HeldAnchored` (also not a clause of the spec), `KInv` and `KAux`
18	  are preserved (`transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable_of_heldAnchored`).
19	* The effect and rejection theorems of §63.
20	-/
21	
22	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access
23	
24	/-! ## Helpers on options and stacks -/
25	
26	/-- Reading `OptP` with default `True` on a present value (§38). -/
27	private theorem optP_true {α : Type} {o : Option α} {P : α → Prop} {y : α} (h : OptP o P True)
28	    (hy : o = some y) : P y := by
29	  subst hy; exact h
30	
31	/-- `OptP` with default `False` holds on a present value (§38). -/
32	private theorem optP_false_iff {α : Type} {o : Option α} {P : α → Prop} :
33	    OptP o P False ↔ ∃ y, o = some y ∧ P y := by
34	  cases o with
35	  | none => exact ⟨fun h => h.elim, fun ⟨_, h, _⟩ => by cases h⟩
36	  | some y => exact ⟨fun h => ⟨y, rfl, h⟩, fun ⟨_, h, hy⟩ => by cases h; exact hy⟩
37	
38	/-- A frame of the stack is its own ancestor (§39). -/
39	private theorem ancestor_self {F : Frames} {f : Nat} (h : f ∈ F) : ancestor F f f := by
40	  unfold ancestor
41	  induction F with
42	  | nil => cases h
43	  | cons g F ih =>
44	    rw [List.dropWhile_cons]
45	    by_cases e : g = f
46	    · subst e; simp
47	    · have hne : (g != f) = true := by simp [e]
48	      simp only [hne, ↓reduceIte]
49	      rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
50	      · exact absurd rfl e
51	      · exact ih h
52	
53	/-- In a duplicate-free stack `f :: F₀`, a frame of `F₀` does not have `f` as an ancestor (§39,
54	§49.1). -/
55	private theorem not_ancestor_top {f g : Nat} {F₀ : Frames} (hnd : (f :: F₀).Nodup) (hg : g ∈ F₀) :
56	    ¬ ancestor (f :: F₀) f g := by
57	  have hn := List.nodup_cons.1 hnd
58	  have hfg : f ≠ g := fun e => hn.1 (e ▸ hg)
59	  unfold ancestor
60	  simp only [List.dropWhile_cons, show (f != g) = true by simp [hfg], ↓reduceIte]

42:| 57.b "On states reachable from `S3.init statics` under `DDSound(K)`, the kernel guarantees `WF3 ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan`" | `reachable_access_invariant_ext` MM03:8581: `(hdd : DDSound k) (h : Reachable k statics s) : WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s ∧ AnchorOrderHeld s ∧ NoOrphan s ∧ ∀ ar ∈ s.arenas, s.Active ar.internal → ArenaInv s ar` | DIFFERS: (1) `WF3` is the draft one (1.G: §49.3 missing, §49.4 weaker, §49.7 replaced by another clause); (2) extra `ArenaInv` conjunct and `S3.arenas`; (3) `Reachable` MM03:8343 also closes under `newArena`, `issue`, `reset` (library operations, §XIV) and under the draft `TransferPre` (draft-only guard MM03:1247, no §63.8), so the set of reached states is not the spec's; (4) `Reachable.init` requires `ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1))`, a premise the spec does not state (P2). |
142:10. **Transfer** (§63.8 added; draft-only `(transferEff s src dst).Usable dst` MM03:1247): semantic question, see P1 — stop and report before deciding. Mechanical impact of any clause change: every positional destructuring of `TransferPre` (`transfer_preserves` 2642, `reachable_anchorOrderHeld` 8542–8543, `init_only_by_writes` 8622–8640, `step_inv57`, `transfer_*`). Semantic impact of removing the draft clause: `transfer_preserves` (§49.8 via `transfer_usable_part … hd'` and `transfer_usable_fwd … hd'`, MM03:2696, 2699), `transfer_usable_fwd` 2612, `transfer_preserves_noDangling` 5836, `transfer_dst_not_owned` 5285 no longer go through, and `check/Cyc.lean` shows the goal is false.
180:Existing: `exitFrame_no_dangling` MM03:5715 and `exitFrame_no_dangling_reachable` MM03:8717 (statement in 1.F). Conclusion matches §39/§73.E1–E2 with §54. Proof uses `RootChain` + draft `RootHeld` + `exit_root_survives` MM03:5663. To prove: restate under `WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s` (spec WF3), proof per item 9; keep the reachable corollary. `check/ND.lean`: a state with spec `RootHeld` (`RootLive` holds), `NoDangling`, frame 1 owning place 0 with root 1 held by frame 1, and a second origin-free `Modify` authority 0 on the same leaf held by frame 0: `ExitStep` is `ok` and authority 0 stays active on the leaf of the dead local; only I1 excludes it.
200:**Reusability under the planned kernel changes** (arenas and `callParams` out of `S3`; enter locals owned by the frame; alloc one root; §63.8 in transfer; WF3 gains §49.3, §49.4, §49.7):
212:**P1 (blocking for (a)/(b)): a `transfer` accepted by §63 breaks §49.8 and `NoDangling`.**
213:Passages: §63 effect "places owned by `r` become owned by `corr(r)`"; §63.7 "All moved held authorities … satisfy `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state"; §44 "`AnchorOrder` requires, for every anchor `x ∈ D(q)` of a **usable** place `q` … `AnchorOrderHeld` imposes the same rule on every active authority held by `q`"; §63.8 (local check on leaves of `corr(r)` only); §49.8 "every active authority is held by a frame present in the stack or by a usable place"; §49 "Preservation of `WF3` by a transition is a required property of transitions"; §58 "An `ok` transition must … preserve the relevant invariants"; §40 "An ownership cycle makes no place usable."
215:§63.1–§63.8 hold: both usable, exercisable `Modify` on 0 (root 0) and on 3 (root 3 via root 2 via root 0); same shape (single leaves); `src` Init, 3 Uninit, disjoint; no pins, no anchors; authority 2 (held by part `src`) moves to `corr(src) = 3` and its footprint `[2]` contains no leaf of 3 (§63.8); in the result place 3 is not usable, so `AnchorOrderHeld` is vacuous for it. Lean confirms every draft `TransferPre` clause except the draft-only `(transferEff s src dst).Usable dst` (MM03:1247).
216:Result: place 2 is owned by 3 and 3 by 2; authority 2 is active, held by the unusable place 3 (§49.8 false) and covers leaf 2 of the unusable place 2 (`NoDangling` false); under the global reading of §49.3 (P3) the cycle also violates WF3.3. The draft rejects the step only through its own clause, which has no spec text. `transfer_frameOf_back` / `transfer_dst_not_owned`).

## Obligations not proved (false), with counterexamples

1. **Preservation of `KInv ∧ KAux` by §63 as written: FALSE.** `transfer_breaks_kinv`. Statics
   `[0 Init, 1 Init]` owned by frame 0; `alloc(provider 1, owner 0, [(none,0)])` → place 2 owned
   by 0, root 2 held by 0; `alloc(provider 1, owner 2, [(none,0)])` → place 3 owned by 2, root 3
   held by 2 (`cyc2`, reachable, `KInv ∧ KAux` decided). `TransferPre K0 cyc2 0 3` decided (all
   eight clauses, §63.8 included). In `cyc3`, places 2 and 3 own each other; root 2 is active,
   held by unusable place 3 (§49.8 fails) and covers leaf 2 of unusable place 2 (`NoDangling`
   fails). `DDSound K0` holds, so this refutes §57 under its own hypothesis. Same as SP-A1 / P1 /
   P6 of the readings and maps, now machine-checked in the module.

2. **`transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable` (`KInv ∧ KAux` + destination usable after ⇒ `KInv' ∧
   KAux'`): FALSE as an implication on `KInv ∧ KAux` states.** Failing invariant:
   `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44, §54); everything else holds
   (`transfer_preserves_wf3_inv3_of_dst_usable`). Cause: the literal quantifier of §63.7 ("All
   **moved** held authorities ... satisfy `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state"). An
   authority held by a place outside the value, whose effective anchor (a root) is held by the
   source or by storage it owns, keeps its holder while its effective anchor's frame changes to
   the destination's; §63.7 does not look at it, and §63.6 `AnchorOrder` sees it only if it is an
   anchor. Counterexample `transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable_fails`, state `ahx`: frames `[1, 0]`;
   place 0 (frame 0), source 1 (owned by 0, `Init`), place 2 (frame 0), place 3 (owned by 1),
   destination 4 (frame 1); roots 0–4; authority 5 derived from root 0 held by frame 1 (gives
   `Modify` on the source through place 0, so §63.4 is not triggered); authority 6 derived from
   root 3, held by place 2, `D` empty. `transfer(1, 4)` is accepted, 4 is usable after, and
   `AnchorOrderHeld` fails for authority 6 (effective anchor now held by 4 in frame 1, holder 2 in
   frame 0). **The state is not reached by kernel steps**: a derived authority is held by a place
   only through `store`, which also anchors it (`HeldAnchored` fails in `ahx`). I could not build
   a reachable counterexample.

   Strongest statement proved: `transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable_of_heldAnchored` (both extra
   hypotheses named and documented as not spec clauses), plus `transfer_preserves_heldAnchored`
   (the extra hypothesis is preserved by `transfer` itself, with no condition).

   **Open**: whether `HeldAnchored` holds on every reachable state. Expected yes (`store` anchors
   what it stores; `release`, `endUse` deactivate what they unanchor; `exitFrame` maps a surviving
   anchor to itself; `derive`/`split`/`enterFrame` keep new or moved authorities frame-held;
   `alloc`/`enterFrame` roots have no origin), but each step's preservation is unproven, and it
   belongs to the per-operation modules. If it holds, the reachable form of obligation 2 holds.

## Readings taken (mine; none changes a definition)

- R1 "§63.8 is local": the decision of `NoLocalSelfLock` depends on the state only through `P`
  and the authorities held within `src` (the LockOptions statement, unchanged).
- R2 `transfer_invalidates_source`: "inaccessible as its former value" (§41) / "cannot be read"
  (§53) read as: no `Read3Pre s' a ls` for any `ls` containing the leaf (the reference `I4`).
- R3 `anchor_escape_rejected_at_transfer` keeps the draft hypothesis `a ∈ depsOf s src`; under the
  reference effect the anchor lands on `corr r`, and the rejection comes from §63.6
  `AnchorOrder (transferEff …)` at `corr r`.
- R4 `HeldAnchored` restricted to derived authorities (`origin ≠ none`) and usable holders: the
  weakest form the proof uses. Root authorities held by places are not anchors (alloc/enter roots)
  and need no hypothesis (a root is its own effective anchor).
- R5 `transfer_deps_follow` adds "no anchor appears from elsewhere" as a fourth conjunct: a
  property of the effect `transferEff` ("no authority is created or duplicated").

## Problems found (for arbitration)

- **P-T1 (= SP-A1, blocking §57 for transfer).** §63 admits an ownership cycle; machine-checked
  reachable counterexample `transfer_breaks_kinv`. Passages: §63 effect "places owned by `r`
  become owned by `corr(r)`"; §49.8; §54 `NoDangling`; §58 "An `ok` transition must ... preserve
  the relevant invariants". The draft's clause "destination usable in the resulting state" is
  sufficient for every invariant except the one in P-T2.
- **P-T2 (new).** §63.7 quotes "All moved held authorities, including those of owned storage,
  satisfy `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state"; §44 "These conditions apply to the resulting
  states of operations that move or create holder relations". An unmoved held authority whose
  effective anchor moves is checked neither by §63.7 nor (if it is not an anchor) by §63.6.
  Example `ahx` above (`transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable_fails`). Harmless on reachable states if
  `HeldAnchored` is an invariant; otherwise needs §63.7 to cover every active authority held by a
  usable place of the resulting state (the draft's full `AnchorOrderHeld s'`).

## Not done

- From the map's §63.8 list (kernel-ops-a), only the locality theorem was in my scope;
  `transfer_selfLock_rejected` and `transfer_no_selfLock` were not requested and not written.
- Per-clause rejection theorems of §63.1–§63.5 were not requested and not written.
